tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje gur rigs bsdus kyi cho ga dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgo zhes bya ba bklag chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ snying rje'i zla ba shes rab nyi ma'i gdong*// gcig 'dres rigs kyi 'od zer 'bum zil nas// 'khor mun bcil ba dgyes pa'i rdo rje yi// snang ba mtshar pos yid mkhar rol bar mdzod// gur nas gsungs pa rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pas/ lus kyi zhen pa zlog pa'i don du bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ ngag gi zhen pa zlog pa'i don du bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ sems kyi zhen pa zlog pa'i don du rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ thun mtshams kyi chos so// dang po la/ rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i he ru ka bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po la chos bcu las/ bla ma dag pa'i cho ga ni/ he badz+ra/ rang nyid skad cig gis mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa yum mā ma ki dang zhal sbyar ba'i skur gyur/ hrīḥlas snying pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha bye ba'i dbus su raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po/ shar du bhūm̐ dkar po/ lhor dz+riṃ ser po/ nub tu aṃ dmar po/ byang du khaṃ ljang khu/ 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal dgyes pa rdo rje rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor shar khyams na rang gi bla ma bzhugs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las byung ba'i gau rī ma nag mos bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ de zin pa'i brdar se gol gcig gtog oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsau ri ma dmar mos pad+ma rak+tas thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ bai tā lī baṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bai tā li ser mos bdud rtsi dri chus thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ghasma rī ljang khus bdud rtsi dri chen gyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par

bsam/ oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ puk+ka si sngon mos sha sna tshogs kyis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sha wa rī dkar mos bdud rtsi sbrang chang gis thod pa bkang nas mchod par bsam/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa li sngon mos cang te'u'i sgras mchod par bsam/ oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ḍom+bi ni khra mos snyoms 'jug gis mchod par bsam mo// yan lag lhag ma drug yid kyis bsgom zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyis te// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma ho sems can kun mgron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog/ ces lan gsum/ he badz+ra man+ḍal muḥtshogs gsog pa'i rten rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad na ci ma rung snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sems can sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba de yang rgyun brtan na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ dgra med gnyen med bshes med zun med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas par bya'o// gsum pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa ni/ de nas/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas snod kyi 'jig rten bcud la bsdu/ de rang gi lus la bsdu/ de yas 'dus mas 'dus pa las snying pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la thim/ de nyi ma la thim/ de sa bon lnga la/ de dag kyang rim gyis 'dus nas/ nā da lngar gyur pa las rang sgra byung bar bsam mo// bzhi pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/

de nas rang gi sems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer rtse mo la rdo rje rgya gram pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'og tu song bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du song bas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng du song bas rdo rje'i gur/ gzhi mo'i nyi ma las me'i 'od zer phyir 'phros pas me ri/ gzhi me'i rdo rje rgya gram pa las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rdo rje'i drwa mig rnams bkag par gyur/ de'i dbus su bhūṃ ser po/ de yongs su gyur pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa'i lte ba dang*/ rtsibs kyi nang du de dag la ma reg pa'i pad nyi/ de'i steng du hūm̐ re/ de yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad mthing kha nyid kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du gshin rje'i gshed sngon po tho ba bsnams pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con/ nub tu rta mgrin dmar po ut+pal dmar po/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa dag sbom la gsus pa ldir ba/ byang shar du 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu/ mer dbyug sngon can dbyug pa/ bden bral du stobs po che rtse gsum/ rlung du mi g.yo ba ri rab bsnams pa bzhi ka nag po/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba dkar po 'khor lo/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po nag po gsal shing bsnams pa/ shar dang steng la rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu snang mtha'/ byang du don grub/ dbus dang 'og mtshams kyi rnams mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang drag shul chen por khros pa'i zhal/ spyan gsum gsum zlum la dmar ba/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ gzugs brjid pa/ bdud rnams bsdigs par mdzad pa/ g.yon rnams snying gar sdigs mdzub/ sbrul gyis brgyan cing stag gi slag pa can zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa nyin mor byed pa'i 'od can/

'khor lo shugs drag por 'khor zhing khro bo rnams mi g.yo ba/ dpag tshad brgya'i bar tshun gyi bgegs thams cad sel ba/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lnga pa chos 'byung ni/ de nas hūm̐ mdzad de 'od du zhu nas chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba/ kha dog dkar po/ drug pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni/ de'i nang du sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam/ bdun pa gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa ni/ 'byung bzhi'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'khor lo de'i dbus su nā da cha gcig zhugs/ de rnams 'dres pa las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ nang gi dbus su rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bcad pa'i le'u tshe lnga/ re re'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa/ phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ lte ba rnams su tshangs pa ser po dang dbang po dkar po gnyis mgo bo g.yas su blta ba/ nye dbang nag po dang drag po sngon po gnyis mgo bo g.yon du blta ba/ 'khor gnas thams cad du nyi ma/ oṃ sarba ta th+wa ga ta a nī la ya ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa mngon par byang chub lngas rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa ni/ lte ba'i bdud bzhi'i steng du a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥtshar gcig brjod pas/ ā li g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gcig las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de mngon par byang chub pa na dang po/ ye shes na/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ ka kha ga gha nga*/

tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥtshar gcig brjod pas de'i steng du kā li g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gcig las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de mngon par byang chub pa na gnyis pa/ ye shes na/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su hūm̐ dang māṃ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa las rim pa bzhin rdo rje dang gri gug sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur/ de mngon par byang chub pa na gsum pa/ ye shes na/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus pa las nyi ma zla ba sa bon phyag mtshan rnams krug gis 'dres pa/ de byang chub pa na bzhi pa/ ye shes na/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ tshur 'dus pa las dbus su rang nyid rgyu'i he ru ka bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa rnams gdong nang du bstan te bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ gnyis pa na chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ gsum pa na rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ bzhi pa na me'i lha mo dmar mo/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ bdun pa na gshin rje nag po/ brgyad pa na nor bdag ser po/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thal mo snying kar sbyar ba zhal phyir bstan te bsnams pa/

thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis brkyang zhing g.yon pa gnyis bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ me ri me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur// de byang chub pa na lnga pa/ ye shes na/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// byang gi pad+ma'i lte ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥtshar gcig brjod pas/ ā li g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gcig las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de mngon par byang chub pa na dang po/ ye shes na/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥtshar gcig brjod pas de'i steng du kā li g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gcig las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de mngon par byang chub pa na gnyis pa/ ye shes na/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su khaṃ dang tāṃ ljang khu las ral gri dang gri gug sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de byang chub pa na gsum pa/ ye shes na/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus pas nyi ma zla ba sa bon phyag mtshan rnams krug gis 'dres pa/ de byang chub pa na bzhi pa/ ye shes na/ bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa las rgyu'i he ru ka don yod grub pa dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal ljang khu/

g.yas zhal nag pa/ g.yon zhal dkar ba/ lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad na rim pa bzhin gza' lhag pa/ phur bu/ mjug ring*/ sgra gcan/ mig dmar/ pa sangs/ spen pa/ khyab 'jug rnams gdong nang du bstan pa/ g.yon gyi thod pa brgyad na rim pa bzhin/ dbang po/ tshangs pa/ drag po/ 'dod lha/ thod pa can/ gcer bu/ thags bzang ris/ stobs ldan rnams gdong phyir bstan te bsnams pa/ phyag dang po gnyis yum la 'khyud pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas brgyan cing*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i phreng bas do shal byas pa/ thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis brkyang zhing g.yon pa gnyis bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i 'phreng bas do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas pa yab la 'khyud cing g.yon brkyang ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna rgyan mgul rgyan lag gdub ska rags te rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ me ri me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ de byang chub pa na lnga pa/ ye shes na/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// dgu pa rdo rje dang pad+ma byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms 'jug bya ba ni/ yum rnams kyi gsang gnas stong pa hrīḥlas pad+ma as ze'u 'bru/ phaṭ ser po zhig gis bug pa bkag pa yab kyis bskul ba/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dhā ra ma hā rā ga su khaṃ tsa tu rā ga si na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/

yab rnams kyi gsang gnas stong pa hūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ gyis nor bu byas pa phaṭ kyis bu ga bkag pa yum gyis bskul/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa tsa tur ā nan+dā ya kā ka mu khe ka rā so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer spros te/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i bcud tshur bsdus te yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ a ba dhu tī nas rdo rje nor bur byang chub sems kyi ngo bo/ dbus kyi yum gyi pad+mar/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ/ saṃ shaṃ tsaṃ ḍaṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥshar gyi yum gyi pad+mar/ paṃ tsaṃ bhaṃ yaṃ/ duṃ suṃ aṃ gaṃ /lho'i yum gyi pad+mar/ suṃ taṃ raṃ baṃ/ laṃ maṃ gaṃ naṃ/ nub kyi yum gyi pad+mar/ paṃ taṃ saṃ yaṃ/ paṃ taṃ duṃ muṃ/ byang gi yum gyi pad+mar/ tsaṃ taṃ k+ṣaṃ kaṃ/ maṃ laṃ paṃ daṃ/ rnams su gyur nas pad+mar spros/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje sems pa'i yan lag go /bcu pa 'khor gyi lha mo rnams bskyed pa ni/ so so'i sa bon de rnams yongs su gyur pa las lha mor gyur te/ pad+ma nas rim pa bzhin 'thon te so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la shar du gau rī ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu/ lhor tsau rī ma ser mo zhags pa/ nub tu bai tā lī dmar mo lcags sgrog byang du ghasma rī ljang khu dril bu/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo ri rab/ shar lhor sha ba rī dkar mo byang sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍā li sngon mo me thab gru gsum/ nub byang du ḍom+bi nī ljang khu rgyal mtshan/ shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog byang sgor dril bu ma ljang khu dril bu bsnams pa/ shar gyi 'dab ma la rim pa de nyid kyis/ skam pa mo dkar mo skam pa/ zhags ldan ma ser mo zhags pa/

nya dol ma dmar mo nya rgya/ lcags kyu ma ljang khu lcags kyu/ me tog ma dkar mo me tog gi snod/ bdug spos ma du ba'i mdog can bdug spos kyi snod/ mar me ma ser mo mar me'i snod/ dri chab ma dmar mo dri'i dung chos/ lho'i 'dab ma la rim pa de nyid kyis/ nyi phyag ma dkar mo nyi ma/ mar me ma ser mo mar me/ sgrol ma dkar mo rin po che/ glog phyag ma ljang khu glog 'khyug pa/ sgeg mo dkar mo phyag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur dkur brten pa/ 'phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis rin po che'i 'phreng ba/ glu ma dmar mo phyag gnyis ting ting shags/ gar ma ljang khu phyag gnyis rdo rje dang bcas gar byed pa/ nub kyi 'dab mar rim pa de nyid kyis/ pad+ma dkar mo pad+ma/ chos 'byung ma ser mo chos 'byung*/ lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog/ 'khyud 'dobs ma ljang khu dril bu/ gling bu ma phyag gnyis gling bu 'bud pa/ rdza rnga ma phyag gnyis rdza rnga brdung ba/ cha lang ma phyag gnyis cha lang 'khrol ba/ dung 'bud ma ljang khu phyag gnyis 'bud dung*/ byang gi 'dab mar rim pa de nyid kyis/ rdo rje sgo lcags ma dkar mo sgo lcags/ lde mig ma ser mo lde mig sgo 'dzin ma dmar mo sgo glegs/ yol 'dzin ma ljang khu yol ba/ spyan ma ser mo 'khor lo// mā ma kī sngon mo rdo rje/ gos dkar mo dmar po pad+ma/ sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal sngon po bsnams shing*/ g.yon dmigs bsal med pa thams cad thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba/ g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ gnyis pa 'bras bu'i he ru ka bskyed pa la bcu las/ dang po dri za nye bar zhugs pa ni/ de nas nam mkha'i nā da rnams skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin byung nas bcom ldan 'das so so'i zhal du zhugs nas yum gyi pad+mar phab pas yum bde ba'i ngo bor zhu/

yum zhu bas yab kyang bde ba'i ror zhu nas dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bur gyur/ gnyis pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis glus bskul ba ni/ rang rang gi mtshams kyi lha mo bzhis gtso bo yab yum med par shes nas mya ngan gyi glus bskul ba ni/ khyod ni rdo rje sdang rnams yongs su skyong mdzad dag pa'i thugs// shin tu rnam dag chos kyis rab tu brgyan pa bzang po'i sku// spos mo bdag la de ring gzigs te stong pa dor mdzod la// 'dren pa 'jig rten pa yi rgyu las skye ba bzhes mdzod cig /khyod ni 'jig rten gti mug yongs su skyong mdzad dag pa'i sku// gzugs brnyan lta bu'i chos kyis rab tu brgyan pa bzang po'i sku// ri khrod ma dag de ring gzigs te stong pa dor mdzod la// 'dren pa 'jig rten pa yi rgyu las skye ba bzhes mdzod cig /khyod ni rdo rje chags pas yongs su skyong mdzad dag pa'i gsungs// nges par so sor rtog pas rab tu brgyan pa bzang po'i sku// gtum mo bdag la de ring gzigs te stong pa dor mdzod la// 'dren pa 'jig rten pa yi rgyu las skye ba bzhes mdzod cig /khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad skyong mdzad thams cad gzugs// thams cad nan tan mnyam pa nyid kyis rab tu rgyas mdzad pa// sme mo bdag la de ring gzigs te stong pa dor mdzod la// 'dren pa 'jig rten pa yi rgyu las skye ba bzhes mdzod cig /ces puk+ka sī la sogs pa bzhis mi bskyod pa la bskul bar bsam/ de bzhin du spos ma la sogs pa bzhi'i gnas su rnam snang la rim pa bzhin/ khyod ni rdo rje sdang rnams= shin tu rnam dag= me tog ma la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni 'jig rten gti mug= gzugs brnyan= bdug spos ma la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni rdo rje chags pas= nges par so sor= mar me ma la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten=

khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad= thams cad nan tan= dri chab ma la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= ces me tog ma la sogs pa bzhis rnam snang la bskul bar bsam/ de bzhin du sgeg mo la sogs pa bzhi'i gnas su rin 'byung la rim pa bzhin/ khyod ni rdo rje sdang rnams= shin tu rnam dag= sgeg mo bdag la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni 'jig rten gti mug= gzugs brnyan lta bus= 'phreng ba ma bdag de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni rdo rje chags pas= nges par so sor= glu ma bdag la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad= thams cad nan tan= gar ma bdag la de ring gzigs te/ 'dren pa 'jig rten= ces sgeg mo la sogs pa bzhis rin 'byung la bskul bar bsam/ de bzhin du gling bu ma la sogs pa bzhi'i gnas su snang mtha' la rim pa bzhin/ khyod ni rdo rje sdang rnams= shin tu rnam dag= gling bu ma la de ring gzigs= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni 'jig rten gti mug= gzugs brnyan la sogs= rdza rnga ma bdag de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni rdo rje chags pas= nges par so sor= cha lang ma la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad= thams cad nan tan= dung 'bud ma la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= ces gling bu ma la sogs pa bzhis snang mtha' la bskul bar bsam/ de bzhin du spyan ma la sogs pa bzhi'i gnas su don grub la rim pa bzhin/ khyod ni rdo rje sdang= shin tu rnam dag= spyan ma bdag la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten pa= khyod ni 'jig rten gti mug= /gzugs brnyan= mā ma kī bdag de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni rdo rje chags pas= nges par so sor= gos dkar mo la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad= thams cad nan tan=

sgrol ma bdag la de ring gzigs te= 'dren pa 'jig rten= zhes spyan ma la sogs pa bzhis don grub la shin tu snyan pa'i glus bskul bar bsam mo/ /gsum pa cho ga gsum gyis 'bras bu'i he ru kar bzhengs pa ni/ sngon gyi smon lam rjes su dran nas dngul chu'i rnam pa lta bu las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las hūm̐ dang māṃ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas mchod/ rdo rje sngon po lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ gri gug yu ba māṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa las dgyes pa rdo rje'i sku phra mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan sku phra mo rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las rang nyid 'bras bu'i he ru ka mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje/ sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa rtsa ba'i zhal nag pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba cher 'jigs pa/ lhag ma'i zhal gnyis gnyis nag pa/ steng zhal dud kha gtsigs pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing spyan rtsa dmar ba dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang dmar po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal kha/ drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na seng ge sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi la gwa pa rnams gdong nang du bstan te bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i thod pa brgyad kyi dang po na sa'i lha mo ser mo/ gnyis pa na chu'i lha mo dkar mo/ gsum pa na rlung gi lha mo dud kha/ bzhi pa na me'i lha mo dmar mo/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha mo dkar mo/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha mo dmar mo/ bdun pa na gshin rje nag po/ brgyad pa na nor bdag ser po/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thal mo snying kar sbyar ba zhal phyir bstan te bsnams pa/

zhes pa'i bar rnams gong ji ltar bzhin du bsgom mo// bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba/ tshon gang ba de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams nas tsam pa'i lte ba la sran chung gshags pa'i ga'u tsam pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ dz+rīṃ āṃ khaṃ rnams spus bris pa tsam pa/ yum rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ māṃ lāṃ tāṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams 'od zer dang bcas pa/ bzhi pa skye mched drug dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtso bo he ru ka rigs lnga rnams kyi mig tu oṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar haṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma nag mo/ sna la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying gi cha stod du a las dbang phyug rdo rje ma sngon mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying gi cha smad du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na gri gug g.yon thod pa/ mchan khung du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bcug pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ro'i gdan gyi steng na bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā la wā si nī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lnga pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bsre ba ni/ gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dgyes pa rdo rje rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/

hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su/ gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur// ces bstod/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas/ slar yang gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/

dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pa la rdo rje sngon po/ rnam snang la 'khor lo dkar po/ rin 'byung la rin po che ser po/ snang mtha' la pad+ma dmar po/ don grub la ral gri ljang kha/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mi bskyod pa'i yan lag go /bdun pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ de nas 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyis sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

'od dpag med kyi yan lag go /brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de nas gtso bo he ru ka rigs lnga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs sdug pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa rnams 'od zer gyis bsdus nas lha snam gyi steng du mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par spros pas/ de rnams kyis he ru ka rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams la mchod pa byed par gyur/ bcom ldan deng 'dir byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag las mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ nī ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag ni gus pas 'bul lags kyis// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā// yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla re'i dri mchog ni// bdag= so sor= dhū pe= gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams// bdag= so sor= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i bshos// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag= so sor= nai wi d+yaṃ= dmar gsal sdug pa dag cing gtsang*// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag ni= so sor= ā lo ke= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// bdag= so sor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa ri' shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ ḍom+bi nīs 'khyud pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen po 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dang*/

rnal 'byor ma rnams dpa' bo'i cha lugs su bsgyur te sku nyams su bstar bar gyur/ ces dang*/ gang gis rnam rtog rnams spangs te// byang chub sems ni rnams bsgom zhing*// lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa// 'di ni don dam mchod pa yin// zhes pas phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gis rgyas btab bo// don yod grub pa'i yan lag go /dgu pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje gzung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ā zhes pas dril bu gzung ste/ mchod pa'i lha mo de rnams kyis gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngang nas he ru ka rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom pa la bstod par gyur/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// kye yi rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal// bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa// mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal// spyi bo'i gdan steng nag po mdzes// dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon// gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni// gnas pa de la gus phyag 'tshal// glang po rta bong glang rnga mo// skyes pa khyi dang ma her bcas// g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i// thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// sa dang chu dang rlung dang me// zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa// g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i// thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po// mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid// nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang mdzad sngo// gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes// 'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i// phyag rgya lnga yis yang dag brgyan// sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan// dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid// dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob// bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal// gaṃ las skyes pa'i gau rī shar// yan lag gnag cing g.yon na nya// g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin// tshangs pa mnan la=

tsaṃ las byung ba'i chom rkun ma// btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su// phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams// dbang po mnan la= baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub// ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan// phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis// rus sbal bsnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor// ljang khu ghaṃ las byung ba yi// phyag na sbrul dang thod pas brel// drag po mnan la= gshin rje mnan cing baṃ las byung*// g.yon na dgra s+t+wa seng ge g.yas// dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma// phyag 'tshal puk+ka sī sngon la// ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung*// me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas// g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa yis// dge slong bsnams la= gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma// srin por tsaṃ las byung ba yi// g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo g.yas// phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la// ḍaṃ las byung ba'i g.yung mo ni// rlung mtshams thags bzang ris steng gshegs// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub// sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas// phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan// gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la// bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phung po khams ni rnam dag pa// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// bde rab ster ni thams cad la// dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo// nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i// phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i// bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la// rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor nas sa bon// gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas// nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni// 'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan// 'di las 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i// zhi ba bde stsol rig ma sdud mdzad pa// shes rab chags pas bdud rtsi ro nyid kyis// gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje// lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas// bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa// des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog/

ces sh+lo ka nyi shu pas bstod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag go /bcu pa bskyed pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam dag dang bcas pa bsgom pa ni/ oṃ dha ra dha/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ marda marda badz+ra dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ zhes pas/ mi bskyod pa yab yum dang*/ gau rī la sogs pa brgyad kyi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan dang rgyan cha lugs shin tu gsal bar gyur/ de 'gres te/ oṃ shā shwa ta pa ra ma shā shwa e dz+yo hi dzi na dzika phaṭ swā hā/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum dang skam pa ma la sogs pa brgyad kyi sogs/ oṃ badz+ra sūr+ya ta ma bi dha ma na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ rat+na dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum dang nyi phyag ma la sogs pa brgyad kyi= oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hu lu hu lu ā ro lika phaṭ swā hā/ snang ba mtha' yas yab yum dang pad+ma ma la sogs pa brgyad kyi= oṃ phu phu phu hi hi hi pradz+nyā dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ don yod grub pa yab yum dang sgo lcags ma la sogs pa brgyad dang*/ lcags kyu ma la sogs pa bzhi rnams shin tu gsal bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ gzhal yas khang dur khrod chen po brgyad rdo rje'i ra ba me ri dang bcas pa shin tu gsal bar gyur/ de'ang gong ma rnams su skabs kyi dmigs pa gang yin pa de la sems zin pa tsam gyis chog la/ 'dir ni rten gzhal yas khang dang brten pa lha dang bcas pa dus gcig tu shin tu gsal bar bsgom pa gal che'o gsungs/ de nas rnam dag bsgom pa/ snying rje'i spyan ni dmar po ste// rdo rje gsum gyi dag pa'i spyan// byams pa'i thugs las yan lag gnag /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni// zhabs ni rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// zhal brgyad rnam par thar pa brgyad// phyag ni stong pa bcu drug nyid// gug kyed kyis ni sangs rgyas lnga// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bor byas// glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo// khrag skyug mdze nad g.yan pa dang*// khong skran pags pa'i rang bzhin rnams// glang po sogs par rab tu grags// gzhang nad dang ni 'bog nad dang*// chu rdo'i nad dang khong gzer nad// rgyu nad sbos nad bkres nad dang*// mig ser nad rnams dred mo sogs// mig tshag dang ni so nad dang*// khrag mkhris dang ni bad rlung dang*// bad kan khrag dang mtshan par brdol// chu nad dang ni 'brum rgod rnams// rma bya la sogs pa rnams yin// rkang skrangs khong sbos mchu so na// rgyu lgangs dang ni klad gzer dang*// 'khru nad tsha nad rkang grum rnams// ka ran ta ka'i bya sogs rnams// rlung mkhris de bzhin ma zhu dang*// ling thog rab rib za gu can// gzhogs phyed nad dang lha gor nad// rlung smyon sogs rnams gza' lhag sogs// sen mo spu dang de bzhin gdung*/

khu ba snang ba mtha' yas so// khrag dang pags pa brjid chen te// rkang dang tshil bu rdo rje 'dzin// de bzhin kun ni rnam snang mdzad// mgo dang nu ma rta bdun pa'o// sa khams rnam par dag pa ni// spyan ma 'khor los mdzes pa'o// de bzhin gsal ba rdo rje dbyings// me ni pad+ma'i bu mo'o// sgrol ma rlung khams dag pa ste// mkha' 'gro skam pa ma yis ni// gdug pa rnams kyis 'khur ba 'don// g.yas pa'i lag na zhags pa ste// gdug pa rnams bcings rnam par dgod// g.yas na nya rgya zlum po ste// gdug pa rnams ni bkri bar 'dod// lag pa g.yas par lcags kyu ste// gdug pa rnams ni dgug par 'dod// lag pa g.yas par nyi ma ste// gti mug mun pa rnam par 'dral// lag pa g.yas par pad+ma yang*// pad+ma 'dod chags sel bar brjod// g.yas par bha ga'i pad+ma ni// bde ba chen po rnam par 'phel// lag pa g.yas par lcags sgrog ste// byang chub zhen pa kun 'ching ba// bdag nyid 'khyud par 'dod pa yang*// byang chub chags pas rab sgrub ma// lag pa g.yas na sgo lcags te// ye shes kun gyi srung ba mo// g.yas pa'i lag tu lde kyog ni// ye shes klong na gcod pa mo// g.yas pa'i lag pas sgo mo ni// ye shes skyes pa ma spangs pa// lag pa g.yas par yol ba ni// rang mtshungs btsun mo srung ba nyid// g.yon pas gdug la sdigs mdzub mdzad// mkha' 'gro ma yi dam pa'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro lnga ni rab bsgrub phyir// mkha' 'gro ma yi rgyu gsungs so//

zhes kun rdzob lha so so'i dag pa dang*/ de thams cad kyang bde stong dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin no// zhes pas rgyas gdab pa ni don dam de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa'o// gnyis pa ngag gi zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir bzlas pa bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rigs so so'i 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad rang rang gi gtso bo'i zhal brgyad dang*/ sgo ma bzhi mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje'i thugs kar zhugs/ yum mā ma ki'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du māṃ gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi'i rim pas/ thig gu bsgril ba/ rma bya'i sboms/ lcags sgrog 'khyil ba/ mda'i shugs lta bu rim pa bzhin sbyar te/ yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ a wa dhū ti nas mar song*/ rdo rje nor bu nas yum gyi pad+mar phab/ pad+ma nas byung ste yang yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs te 'khor bar dmigs la/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ marda marda badz+ra dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ mi bskyod pa'i'o// de bzhin rigs lnga so so'i ting nge 'dzin la res 'jog gis bzla bar bya ba ste/ rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje'i yum sangs rgyas spyan ma'i thugs kar zla dkyil gyi steng du lāṃ gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer sogs gong ltar 'gres/ oṃ shā shwa ta pa ra ma shā shwa e dz+yo hi dzi na dzika phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ rnam snang gi'o// rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje'i yum sgrol ma'i thugs kar zla dkyil gyi steng du tāṃ gyi mthar sngags kyi bskor ba las 'od zer sogs gong ltar 'gres/ oṃ badz+ra sūr+ya ta ma bi dha ma na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ rat+na dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ rin 'byung gi'o// snang mtha' dgyes pa rdo rje'i yum gos dkar mo'i thugs kar zla dkyil gyi steng du pāṃ gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer sogs gong ltar 'gres/

oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hu lu hu lu a ro l̥ka phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ 'od dpag med do// don grub dgyes pa rdo rje'i yum sgrol ma'i thugs kar zla dkyil gyi steng du tāṃ gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer sogs gong ltar 'gres/ oṃ phuḥphuḥphuḥhi hi hi/ pradz+nyā dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ zhes bzla/ don grub kyi'o// bzlas pa la skyo na de'i thun zhabs thams cad la mchod pa lnga dang bstod pa bya ste yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas smon lam gdab/ mthar thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang la thim/ de yang rigs bzhi la 'dus/ rnam snang sogs bzhi po gtso bo mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje'i thugs kar bsdus nas gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rdzogs rim bsgom/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis par bsgyur te nang bcud lha dang lha mo/ phyi snod gzhal yas khang gi rnam par bltas la de dag thams cad kyang rdzogs rim gyi nyams skye med kyis rgyas gdab bo// gsum pa gzhan du bshad do// bzhi pa thun mtshams kyi chos la/ mdun du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang gi steng du pad+ma dkar po dang*/ bar du nag po dang*/ 'og tu dmar po rnams 'dab ma brgyad pa brtsegs pa/ rang gi spyi bo'i sku rdo rje las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas gzugs med srid pa'i lha tshogs nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i bar gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od kyis bsdus nas mdun gyi pad+ma dkar po'i dbus su oṃ dkar po cig tu gyur/ snying ga'i thugs rdo rje las 'od zer nag po 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu dang pha ma la sogs pa 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma nag po'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po cig tu gyur/ mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas sa steng gi mi/ sa 'og gi klu/ dmyal ba yi dwags byol song thams cad 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma dmar po'i dbus su āḥdamar po cig tu gyur/

yi ge gsum po dag las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las 'khor lo las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ rdo rje las thugs rdo rje sku mdog nag po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ pad+ma las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gsum spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥ tsau rī hūm̐/ bai tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas la/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas sku rdo rje la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ yang rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te mchod par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥham̐'u baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/

nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtor ma'i mgron thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa de las 'od zer sbu gu can byung bas gtor ma la reg ste 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ in+d+ra/ ya mā/ dzā la/ yak+ṣa/ bhū ta/ ba ni/ wā yu/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ mā ta/ pa byā tā la/ pa tā la/ aṣ+ṭa/ sa byā swā hā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dziṃ ga puṣ+pe/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ bid+ga/ at+ma/ sarba/ kan+dza swā hā/ khan+ti/ khu ti/ bi ta ga ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇī ad+ya nut+pan na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub bsgrubs pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams mnyes nas ha ha/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥzhes ye shes kyi gad mo bcu gnyis sgrogs shing*/ sgrub pa po khyod kyi yid la ci 'dod pa bdag cag rnams kyis bsgrub par bya'o zhes khas len par gyur/

lha chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad rnams dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams= yi dwags tshogs= sha za'i tshogs= smyo byed tshogs= brjed byed tshogs= mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa kun// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// dbang dang mngon spyod dgra 'joms dang*// dgar dang bsad dang dgug pa dang*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// mkha' 'gro'i byad sogs med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams rgyas shing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs shog/ ces phrin las bcol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ muḥgator ma'i mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ chos skyong gi gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na skabs 'di nyid du gtang bar bya'o// de nas cang te'u dkrol zhing*/ kol+la i reṭ+ṭi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ṭā ho badz+dza i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i ṇa ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza ī/ ga ḍeṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pā ṇi a i/ du na dhu ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tsha ri si h+la/ kaspu ra lā i a i/ mā la i in+dha ṇa sā li dza/ ta he bhi ru kha i a i/

pheṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dhaṇ+ṇa ma ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su aṅga tsa ḍi wa/ ta hiṃ dza sa ra wa pā ṇi a i/ mā la a tse kun+tu ru bā ḍa i/ ḍāṃṇ+ḍi ma ta hiṃ ṇ+ṇa badz+dza a i/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zasacan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing*// 'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rje bsngags pa yi// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang*// bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa'o/// / dbang gi cho ga rigs bsdus pa dang bye brag 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam khyad/ gzhan dngos grub gter mdzod ji lta ba'o// zhes gsungs pa nyid bklag chog tu dgod par bya ste// ༄༅// dkyil 'khor gyi las rim la/ sa chog sta gon/ dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga gsum las/ dang po la lnga las/ gnas brtag pa ni/ tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i khyim dang ni// dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang du yang*// dkyil 'khor dam pa rab tu bzheng*// zhes gsungs pa'i gnas so// gnyis pa sa bslang ba ni/ mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ sngon du 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha sogs nas mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du zhu ba dang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur zhes byin gyis brlab/ dril bu dkrol zhing ngag tu/ in+d+ra sogs sam bsdus par a kā ro nyid kyis kyang rung ste lan gsum brjod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas//

zhes pas 'phrin las bcol/ yig brgya'i mthar muḥ zhes brjod/ se gol lan gsum gtog gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs/ gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags zab mo nyan pa la mi mos shing phyag rgya sna tshogs blta ba la mi dbang*/ ting nge 'dzin zab mo bsgom pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod byed 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di sbyin no// gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa thams cad nye bar zhi nas phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par rang rang so so'i gnas dang rten gang yin la phar dengs shig suṃ bha ni brjod cing rol mos bskrad/ de nas/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bar gyis/ yan lag drug pa'i bskyed rim bsgom ste/ mthar 'khor rnams yum/ yum yab la/ de he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ zhes dkyil 'khor bsdus nas phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i dbus su dri yi thig le gcig bya/ me tog gi tshom bu gcig dgram/ de la baṃ las sa'i lha mo lte ba yan chad sa gseb nas 'thon pa/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa khas len gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas/ bdag gis ci bgyid zer ba cig tu gyur/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon lha mo che// sa yi lha mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ba'i// mchog gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan// mgul do zhabs gdub sil sil can// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes mdzod la// dkyil 'khor las rnams rab tu sgrubs/ hrīḥhī hī hī hī baṃ swā hā/ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/

oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i/ oṃ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dhū pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= ā lo ke= shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod pa lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas/ gtor ma bsangs sbyang*/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// kyai yi rdo rje khro mchod pa'i// lha mo khyod ni dpang du 'gyur// che ge/ bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sa'i lha mos/ sa'i phyogs 'dir khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bris shig ces gnang ba sbyin nas ye shes sems dpa' gshegs/ dam tshig sems dpa' de nyid du thim par gyur/ gsum pa bya bas sbyang ba ni/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba/ brkos la sa'i skyon lnga bsal nas stegs bu ngos rer tshon gsum gyis lhag pa'i khru gsum/ dbus cung zad mtho ba/ mtha' bags kyis dma' zhing zhal bas 'jam par byas pa/ ba'i rnam lnga'i dri bzang gis rkyang nul legs par bya'o// sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba ni/

de nas rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis lag pa gnyis sa la bzhag la sa'i nyes pa'i skyon thams cad dag par bsams la/ oṃ dhā ra dhā ra/ sogs rigs lnga'i sngags sam hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ dz+rīṃ aṃ khaṃ zhes pa'i sa bon lan bdun bzla'o// bzhi pa sa srung ba ni/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus hūm̐ las ral gri de'i lte ba la hūm̐ de'i 'od zer las rdo rje rgya gram phyogs mtshams thams cad du gtams par bsam zhing*/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ brjod pas sa gzhi bsrung*/ oṃ me di ni swā hā/ ye shes kyi sa bkug nas de la bstim/ lnga pa sa gzung ba ni/ sta gon gyi phyir mchod pa dang rten bsham/ gnas nye bar brgyan par bya'o// nub dang po'i 'o// gnyis pa sta gon gyi cho ga la bzhi las/ dang po bgegs bsal ba ni/ gnas der bum pa la sogs pa'i sta gon gyi yo byad dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas lag len bzhin du bshams te/ slob dpon stegs bu'i dbus su phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te phyi dro'i dus su in+d+ra'i gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar bsnyen pa bzhin du byas nas 'khor mi bsdu bar bzlas pa ci rigs par bya/ mchod g.yog pa bzhi gau rī ma sogs lha mo bzhi'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje dril bu thogs/ thog mar shar nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis gau rī ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang tshangs pa'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su

gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= ces mchod yon sogs dang rnam lngas mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub sgrub pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod// de nas bskul ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// lho phyogs nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis tsau rī ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang dbang po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ bskul ba ni/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spang*// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol/ nub phyogs nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis bai tā li ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang nye dbang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ bskul ba ni/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// byang nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis ghasma rī ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/

mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan zhing*/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa zhabs g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis pad+ma dang drag po'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas/ bskul ba ni/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// de nas slob dpon gyis/ yum dang bcas pa'i rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag nyid la thim zhes/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ bdag nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭā las nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor der hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje re res mtshan par gyur/ rab tu myur zhing g.yo ba'i mig gis blta zhing dbus su langs te nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ kha yi pad+ma 'dzum dang bcas// cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'chang*// kun+da dkar gsal so yi 'phreng*// dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che// sems can sgrol ba rmad du byung*// de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni// bgegs la sogs pa bskrad par bya// zhes brjod la rdo rje dril bu bcas pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas/ shar gyi phyogs nas kha nang du bstan te bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sbyor ba po// rdo rje rtse mo 'bar ba yis// lus srul las skyes 'gas byas te// rmongs pa'i bdag nyid gang 'da' ba// tshal par dgas kyis gzhan du min// bde chen ye shes rdzogs 'tshang rgya// rdo rje sems dpa' dngos las skyes// lus srul po ni gang su dag /bgegs chen po rnams so sor song*/ sa yi phyogs 'dir bdag rdo rje slob dpon

'di zhes bya bas slob ma rnams rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya ba dang*/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhig 'bri yis/ gang su yang rung ba/ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ smyo byed dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ gnon po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang*/ rgan mo dang*/ g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ ka ra shin tu khros pa ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṇāṃ/ na maḥsaman+ta dharmā nāṃ/ na maḥsaman+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra t+yaṅgir/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra brti/ sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra/ mū la karma/ ban+dha naṃ/ tā ḍa naṃ/ kī la naṃ bā ma ma kṛ te ye na ke na tsi ta kṛ tan+tā tra/ sarban+tu/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ mā ra mā ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sngags dang*/ namaḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ mahā daṃṣ+ṭo ka ṭa bhe ra bā ya/ oṃ da ka ta/ badz+ra san+to haṃ/ dar+pa ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ rtsa sngags kyang bzla/ de rnams lan gsum brjod cing*/ dang por rdo rje gsor/ tha mar dril bu dkrol/ dbang ldan nas brtsams te hūm̐ mang po brjod cing g.yas skor du lan gsum bskor te/ he ru ka'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam/ slar yang dbang ldan gyi mtshams nas

rang nyid bdag med ma'i skur gsal bar gyur/ zhes pa'i nga rgyal gyis hi mang po brjod cing g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ yang na dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis g.yas brkyang gis 'dug ste rdo rje dril bu gzung ba'i lag pas gar bsgyur zhing hūm̐ 'ba' zhig 'don pa dang*/ bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis g.yon brkyang gis 'dug ste hi 'ba' zhig brjod par bya'o// slar yang*/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal bar gyur/ rang gi sems nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i lte ba la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer rtse mo la rdo rje rgya gram pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ 'og tu song bas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar snang du song bas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba steng du song bas rdo rje'i gur/ gzhi mo'i nyi ma las me'i 'od zer phyir 'phros pas me ri/ gzhi mo'i rdo rje rgya gram pa las rdo rje rkyang pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rdo rje'i drwa mig rnam bkag par gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs par bsam mo// gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po lha sta gon ni/ stang stabs byas pa'i sa rdul 'phyags la/ chang dang bdud rtsi'i ril bu sbyar bas gzhal yas khang gi tshad tsam zlum por byugs/ 'chad 'gyur ltar las thig rdzogs par gdab/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i gtso bo lnga'i gnas su dri'i thig le gru bzhi/ de rnams kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad brgyad dang sgo bzhir zlum por blugs/ oṃ dha ra la sogs pa'i sngags brjod cing dbus dang*/ oṃ gaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du/ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ tsaṃ ḍaṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnams la sbyar bas dbus kyi ling tshe'i phyogs mtshams brgyad dang sgo bzhi/ shar du rnam snang gi snying po dang*/ saṃ pāṃ bāṃ aṃ puṃ dhuṃ āṃ gaṃ

rnams oṃ dang swā hā 'i bar du bcug pas de'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ lhor rin 'byung gi snying po dang*/ sūṃ dīṃ raṃ biṃ lāṃ māṃ gīṃ nṛṃ rnams oṃ dang swā hā 'i bar du bcug la brjod cing de'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ nub tu snang mtha'i snying po dang*/ paṃ dhaṃ sboṃ āṃ baṃ ḍoṃ taṃ phuṃ rnams oṃ dang swā hā 'i bar du bcug pas de'i phyogs mtshams brgyad/ byang du don grub kyi snying po dang*/ taṃ kuṃ kaṃ paṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams oṃ dang swā hā 'i bar du bcug pas brjod cing de'i phyogs mtshams brgyad rnams su me tog gi tshom bu dgram/ mar me lha bshos spos kyi reng bu me tog gis bkang ba'i snod dri bzang po sbyar ba'i chab rnams re re bzhin bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'am/ ma 'dzom na cha drug bsham/ gur gyi srog shing gi dgongs don ltar cung zad bsdus pa'i dbang du mdzad nas rngog pa rnams sa bon nam snying po brjod pa tsam gyis rten brten pa bskyed par bzhed cing*/ de las bsdu na/ rten mi bskyed pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ lugs de ltar byed na/ snying po ni gtso bo lnga dkyus ltar dang*/ dbus kyi lha mo brgyad ni/ oṃ āḥgau rī hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'bru gsum phaṭ bcas pa rigs 'gres su sbyar te/ tsau rī/ bai tā li/ puk+ka sī/ ghasma rī/ sha ba ri/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ ḍom+bi nī/ shar ni/ san+ta shā/ pā shi nī/ bā gu rā/ aṃ ku shā/ puṣ+pā/ dhū pā/ dī pā/ gan+dhā/ lho ni/ sūr+ya has+t+wa/ dī pa/ rat+no lkā/ ta ḍi ta ka ta rā/ lā s+ya/ mā lā/ gī tā/ nṛ t+yā/ nub ni/ pad+mā/ dharmo da yā/ s+pho ṭā/ su sh+le ṣā/ baṃ shwa/ mu ra dz+wa/ ta li sha rwa/ phuṅge/ byang ni/ tā lā/ ku ñtsi kā/ ka pā ṭā/ pa ṭa dhā ri ṇī/ lo tsa nā/ mā ma kī/ pāṇ+ḍa rā/ tā re/ sgo ma bzhi ni/ aṃ ku shā/ pā shā/ spo ṭā/ gaṇ+ṭā/ zhes rnams te de tsam gyis dkyil 'khor 'khor lo skad cig la bskyed nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa la 'jug pa yin no// 'on kyang da lta'i phyag len du mngon rtogs kyi tshig rgyas par brjod nas gsal 'debs par mdzad de de ltar na tshom bu bshams zin pa'i rjes de nyid du/

sangs sbyangs/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor 'di nyid rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang nas āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bar dang*/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang māṃ mthing ga las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ dang laṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ lho yi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du dz+riṃ dang tāṃ ser po las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ nub kyi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du āṃ dang paṃ dmar po las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las snang ba mtha' yas dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ byang gi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du khaṃ dang tāṃ ljang khu las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las don grub dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad dang sgo bzhir gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ tsaṃ ḍaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnams las shar du gau rī ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu sogs nas dril bu bsnams pa bar dang*/ shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la paṃ tsaṃ bhaṃ yaṃ duṃ suṃ aṃ gaṃ rnams las rim pa de nyid kyis skam pa mo dkar mo sogs nas dri yi dung chos bar/ lho yi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la suṃ taṃ raṃ baṃ/

laṃ maṃ gaṃ naṃ rnams rim pa de nyid kyis nyi phyag ma dkar mo sogs nas rdo rje dang bcas gar byed pa bar/ nub kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la paṃ taṃ saṃ yaṃ/ paṃ taṃ duṃ muṃ rnams las rim pa de nyid kyis pad+ma dkar mo pad+ma sogs nas phyag gnyis 'bud dung bar/ byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la tsaṃ taṃ k+ṣaṃ kaṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ daṃ rnams las rim pa de nyid kyis rdo rje sgo lcags ma sogs nas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa bar/ lha mo de thams cad sogs nas me ri me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang rang 'dra ba tshon gang ba de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje/ 'khor lo sogs tāṃ rnams las 'od zer dang bcas pa/ gtso bo he ru ka rigs lnga rnams kyi mig tu oṃ las sogs ro yi gdan gyi steng du bzhugs pa'o// gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dgyes pa rdo rje rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu'i nang du bcug la des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas lag pa g.yon pas dril bu dkrol zhing g.yas pas mchod rdzas gang yin de blangs la btab pa'i tshul gyis 'bul/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu gzung la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rjes bdag la skyobs// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la stsol// phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po kun// las kun rab tu sgrub byed pa// thams cad rdo rje'i bdag mgur 'gyur/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas/ slar yang gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/

zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pa la rdo rje sngon po/ rnam snang la 'khor lo dkar po/ rin 'byung la rin po che ser po/ snang mtha' la pad+ma dmar po/ don grub la ral gri ljang khu/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong gi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon lnga las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi khams na gzugs sdug pa sogs nas/ de rnams kyis he ru ka rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor la mchod pa byed par gyur/ mchod pa ni/ yan lag bdun ldan ar+gha'i rgyun sogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi mchod pa rgyas btab bcas/ bstod pa/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog/ sogs nas/ des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog/ bar dang*/ rgyas par spro na/ gang dang gang gis thabs mkhas kyis// sogs mthar sngags kyi rgyas gdab bcas bya'o// de nas/ bdud rtsi'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha sogs nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi myang ba'i rgyas btab gyi bar byas nas/ spos kyi reng bu thogs te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag dngos grub bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// bdag med ma dang yang dag ldan// phyogs mtshams rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul ldan// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pa// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol//

zhes gsol ba gdab bo//( sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes bya'o//) gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rgyas par bzhi bcu rtsa dgu/ bsdus par bum pa lnga/ las bum dang bcas phyi nang thams cad bkru/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags brjod/ bgegs bskrad/ rang rang gi mtshan ma bris/ nang du gser/ dngul/ mu tig mu men/ byu ru ste rin po che lnga dang*/ kan+ḍa kā ri/ dan+ḍo t+pa la/ gu gul dkar po/ dbang lag pad+ma'i rtsa ba ste sman lnga/ nas/ gro/ til/ 'bras/ mā sha ste 'bru lnga dang*/ tsan+dan dkar po/ dzā ti/ ga pur/ gur gum/ gla rtsi ste dri lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ slob dpon rtogs pa dang ldan na sha lnga yang gzhug chu gtsang gis dgang*/ ras kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul pa bcings/ shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i 'dab ma 'bras bur bcas pas kha brgyan/ ras dkar dri ma med pa'i steng du me tog gcal du bkram pa la lha dgod pa'i go rim bzhin du bzhugs su gsol/ bsdus pa'i skabs bum pa lnga phyogs bzhi dbus lnga dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa byang shar mtshams su bzhag bum pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa lnga tshang bar bsham/ de nas gtso bum gyi shing lo'i khar bdud rtsi dang chang sbyar bas bkang ba'i thod pa bzhag de'i steng du rdo rje'i lte bar me tog gi 'phreng ba brgyus pa'i gzungs thag btags te/ rgyas pa'i phyogs la gtso 'khor rnams so so bzhin bskyed cing drangs bstim/ mchod bstod bzlas pa 'od zhu bcas lha re re bzhin bya dgos la/ bsdus par na bum pa shu n+ya tā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ yig lnga zhu ba las rin po che'i bum pa lnga phyi'i dbyibs bum pa/ nang gzhal yas khang 'od lhag ge lhang nger gyur pa'i dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po

zhes pa nas me ri me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du gau rī ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu/ lhor tsau rī ma ser mo zhags pa/ nub tu bai tā lī dmar mo lcags sgrog byang du ghasma rī ljang khu dril bu/ byang shar puk+ka sī sngon mo ri rab/ shar lhor sha ba rī dkar mo byang sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍā li sngon mo me thab gru gsum/ nub byang du ḍom+bi nī ljang khu rgyal mtshan/ pad+ma'i phyi yi shar du lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu/ lhor zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog byang du dril bu ma ljang khu dril bu bsnams pa/ shar gyi bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dkar po sogs nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la rim pa bzhin skam pa ma dkar mo skam pa sogs nas dri yi dung chos bar/ lho yi bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa ba'i zhal ser po sogs nas me ri dang me dpung gi nang bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la rim pa bzhin nyi phyag ma dkar mo nyi ma sogs nas phyag gnyis rdo rje dang bcas gar byed pa/ nub kyi bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du snang ba mtha' yas dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa dmar po sogs nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la rim pa bzhin pad+ma dkar mo pad+ma sogs nas phyag gnyis 'bud dung bar/ byang gi bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du don yod grub pa dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal ljang khu

sogs nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la rim pa bzhin rdo rje sgo lcags ma dkar mo sogs nas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ 'khor gyi lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig sogs nas me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dgyes pa rdo rje rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ ces pa'i bar gyis bskyed/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur/ yang gtso bo rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis bum pa'i lha la dbang bskur bas gtso bo lnga la rang rang gi rigs kyi phyag mtshan dang*/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ gis mchod rdzas kyi bgegs bsal/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis/ mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs nas mchod par gyur/ me tog bzang po mdzes shing gtsang*// gtsang ma'i gnas skyes 'di rnams ni// bdag ni gus pas 'bul lags kyis// so sor bzhes te dgyes par mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā// yid dga' snying po ro mchog ldan// bdug pa bla re'i dri mchog ni// bdag= so sor= dhū pe= gtsang zhing bzang la dge ba'i dri// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams// bdag= so sor= gan+dhe= gtsang zhing gtsang la dge ba'i bshos// skyes gnas gtsang mar ldan 'di rnams/ bdag= so sor= nai wi d+yaṃ= dmar gsal sdug pa dag cing gtsang*// dge zhing mun sel mar me 'di// bdag ni= so sor= ā lo ke= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// bdag=

so sor= oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bstod pa ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis khyod dgongs 'grub// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu 'khor ba kun 'grub pa// snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can byang chub tu// kun rdzob sgyu ma byang chub bsgrubs pa'i yid// dgyes pa rdo rje dpal ldan he ru ka la bstod/ zhes pas bstod/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ bdud rtsi'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa/ de'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bas shin tu mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ tā swa da badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi phul/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril nas bum pa'i nang du song zhing*/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang lha mo rnams kyi bha ga'i rdul gyis bum pa gang bar gyur/

oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ marda marda badz+ra dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ mi bskyod pa'i'o// oṃ shā shwa ta pa ra ma shā shwa e dz+yo hi dzi na dzika phaṭ swā hā/ rnam snang gi'o// oṃ badz+ra sūr+ya ta ma bi dha ma na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ rat+na dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ rin 'byung gi'o// oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hu lu hu lu ā ro lika phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ phu phu phu hi hi hi pradz+nyā dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ don grub kyi'o// gtso bo lnga yi snying po lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de bzhin du/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa rā ti hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ mo ha rā ti= rat+na rā ti= rā ga rā ti= badz+ra rā ti= ces yum lnga'i sngags kyang cung zad re bzla/ mthar thod pa'i bdud rtsi bum par blug pas bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur/ las bum shū n+ya tā sa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rum̐ zhu ba las rin po che'i bum pa phyi dbyibs bum pa nang gzhal yas khang 'od lhag ge lhang nge bar gyur pa'i nang du hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon sdigs mdzub/ khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā sogs/ nai wīd+ya āḥhūm̐ bar gyis mchod pa lngas mchod/ thugs kar nyi dkyil la hūm̐ sngon po las sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ ces brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba mi bzhu bar sku las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang lha de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar mtshams su bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi las ma grub kyi bar du bgegs ma rungs pa rnams srung bar mdzad du gsol// zhes 'phrin las bcol lo// grub na dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su sbyin bsreg bya'o// gsum pa slob ma sta gon la chos bcu gnyis las/

dang por slob ma'i bar chad zhi ba'i phyir in+d+ra'i sngags kyis gtor ma btang*/ de nas yol ba'i phyi rol tu las thams cad pa'i chus khrus bya gos gtsang ma gyon bla ma la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ gnyis pa gsang sngags kyi chos la mos pa 'jug pa ni/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gnas pa la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/

sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// gzhan ni 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// slar yang dad dang ldan pa yis// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs te// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug par bya// 'di yi 'bras bu mi gnyer te// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sems bskyed kyi don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan pa// sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab tu gzhug bzhi pa slob dpon gyis gsang sngags kyi theg par blo dgug par bya ba ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi// gsang sngags spyod tshul chog ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// gang dag de bzhin ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pa// skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru ka /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig/ ces brjod/ lnga pa nyan par rna ba gtad par bskul ba ni/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang pos legs par nyon// brjed ngas blo la he ru ka sogs pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob//

ces brjod/ drug pa rgyud dag par bya ba'i don du lnga rnam dag bya ba ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag thams cad bshags par bya// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod rnams la// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las grol// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de nyid du ni sems bskyed do// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug bdun pa slob ma rab gnas ni/ slob ma skad cig gis he ru ka phyag gnyis par bskyed la/ slob dpon gyis dri bzang po'i chu dang bcas pa'i rdo rje lag tu thogs nas gnas gsum du mas rim gyis gtug cing*/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po cig sgoms shig ces brjod do// yang rdo rje yas rim gyis gtug cing*/ hūm̐ de rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ āḥde pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ oṃ de 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan par sgoms shig ces bya ste/ phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa de'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sku gsung thugs rdo rje bkug rang rang gi sa bon la bcug par sgoms shig de la slob dpon gyi mchod pa lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod par bya'o// brgyad pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i don du so shing sbyin pa ni/ mchod sbyin gyi shing lcang ma'am shug pa'am 'om bu la sogs pa 'bus ma zos shing ma yo ba dang gas pa dang chag pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad dri'i chus brlan zhing me tog gi 'phreng bas brgyan pa

oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas te slob ma'i thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du sbyin/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ mi smra ba ni so shing bca'// bca' zhing de bzhin mi dgas shing*// phan tshun du yang mi 'dor ro// so shing mdun du drang por dor// zhes bshad pas kha shar phyogs su bltas la so shing gi rtsa ba cung zad 'jib pa'i tshul dang*/ de nas mgo mjug bsgyur la rtse mo 'jib pa'i tshul dang*/ de nas rtsa bas so drud pa'i tshul du gyis la rtse mo gyen du bstan pa maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dor zhig de nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa ni/ de yi tshe na mtshan ma ni// de tshe bdag la blta ba dang*// rtse mo gyen du bsgreng gyur na// de ni dngos grub mchog ces bshad// de bzhin shar du blta na ni// de ni dngos grub 'bring du bshad// mtshams dang byang du kha bltas na// 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub 'thob// so shing 'dor ba rgya zhig la// gal te thur du kha bltas na// de ni nges par sa 'og gi /dngos grub de la the tshom med// ces pa'i tshul gyis brtag par bya'o// dgu pa khyor chu sbyin pa ni/ dri bzang po'i chu khyor bar lan gsum sngags 'dis 'thung du gzhug ste/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmāḥsar+b+ba pā pa ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sar+b+ba bi kalpan a pa nā ya hūm̐/ des rnam par rtog pa thams cad sbyang bar bya'o// bcu pa rmi lam gyi ltas brtag pa'i don du ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i chun po dri chus bsangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas pa'i nyung ba sngas dang mang ba stan gyi don du sbyin no// bcu gcig pa bar chad bsrung ba'i don du srung skud gdags pa ni/ skud pa dmar po la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis btab pa'i srung skud mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas su gdags/ de la dri'i chus byug bcu gnyis pa spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir zab rgyas kyi chos bshad pa ni/
