'jig rten khams ni ma lus par// thams cad mkhyen pa 'byung mi 'gyur// u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'dis// sems can sangs rgyas byed pa yin// bskal pa grangs med mang por ni// sngon du byas pa'i rnam smin gang*// de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// zhes brjod/ nus na dge sbyor gyis/ mi nus na seng ge'i nyal stabs su dgyes pa rdo rje yid la gyis la nyol la rmi lam du gang rmis pa de nang par nga la smros shig ces brjod la gnas khang de nyid du nyal du gzhug go /de nas slob dpon yol ba'i nang du zhugs te dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod/ dge ba bsngo ba/ 'dod don gsol ba rnams byas te yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla/ mar me dang spos mtshan thub phul te ci bde bar nyal lo// nang par slob dpon gyis rmi lam ci rmis zhes dris/ des kyang ji ltar rmis pa smra'o// ltas brtag pa ni rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong ba na/ zhes sogs byung na bzang*/ mun nag btson rar tshud pa sogs byung na ngan pas de rnams bzlog pa'i thabs ni/ ba'i rnam lnga dang bsres pa'i btung ba la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags btab pa 'thung du bcug pas kyang bzlog bdud rtsi lnga'i chu 'thung du bcug pa dang*/ chos thams cad rmi lam ltar yid la byed du bcug pa dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams kyis kyang bzlog go /gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga la bzhi las/ dang po thig tshon gyi cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha/ sngar btegs med na badz+rod tiṣ+ṭha zhes pas nam mkhar bteg de nas bskyed rim yan lag drug ldan bsgoms te/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la las kyi he ru kar gyur nas shes rab ma mtshan dang ldan pa'am/

sgrub pa'i grogs mchog gis bkal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur longs pa'i tshon sna lnga'i skud pa/ slob dpon rtogs pa dang ldan na oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bde stong gi ngo bor byin gyis brlab/ rnam par rtog pa shas che na thod pa'i nang du bzhag des shū n+ya tā sa bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skud pa sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po sogs nas bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa bar/ dkar po bh+rum̐ las rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dkar po sogs nas bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa bar/ ser po dz+riṃ las rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal ser po sogs nas bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa bar/ dmar po aṃ las snang mtha' dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal dmar po sogs nas bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa bar/ ljang khu khaṃ las don grub dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa zhal ljang khu sogs nas bdud bzhi'i snying ga mnan pa bar/ he ru ka rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi rigs lnga spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥtsau rī hūm̐/ bai tā lī baṃ/ ghasmā rī hoḥ.oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lngas mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rigs lnga 'od du zhu nas thig tu gyur/ thig skud rnams grogs dang bcas te bsgril nas ye shes kyi thig gdab pa ni/ slob dpon shar na gnas pas dzaḥdzaḥ zhes thig gi sna grogs kyi lag tu gtad/ des kyang skud pa'i sna gzung la rgyab nas bskor te nub tu song la/ sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ thig skud kyi sgras 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la khyed kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dus yin no zhes bskul bar bsams la tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du bskor te grogs lho dang slob dpon rgyab nas bskor te byang du gnas pas gnyis pa/

de nas grogs kyis rgyab nas bskor te dbang ldan dang*/ slob dpon gyis bskor te mer 'dug la shar gyi logs thig slob mas bskor te bden bral dang*/ slob dpon gyis bskor te rlung du gnas pas nub kyi logs thig slob dpon de nyid dang grogs kyis bskor te dbang ldan du gnas pas byang gi thig slob dpon gyis rgyab nas bskor te me dang grogs kyis bskor te bden bral du gnas pas lho thig slob dpon de nyid dang grogs rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po/ slob dpon bden bral dang grogs dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis pa rnams gdab cing chad pa dang ring thung phyogs 'khrul sogs nyes skyon dang bral bar bya/ de ltar thig chen brgyad gnam thig tu gdab bo// thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ las thig man ngag bzhin gdab/ tshon thig bzhin byin gyis brlab/ pra brtag pa ni 'khor lo'i dbus su 'dug ste kha phyir blta bas byang shar gyi mtshams su phyi mthar dkar po/ de nas ser dmar ljang nag po rnams 'khyig gang tsam g.yon pas 'then/ thod pa steng du bkab ste de'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab grol ba// rgyal chen dgyes pa rdo rje yi// dkyil 'khor rab tu bri bar bya// zhes brjod de me tog gcig gtor la/ thams cad mnyam zhing bar chad med// ngan pa dang ni nyams pa dang*// ma snyoms pa dang bar chad na// gnod pa mang po 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes pa ltar tshon pra brtag de nas lte ba nas rim par man ngag bzhin bris nas thig skud dang tshon lhag ma'i ye shes pa gshegs par bya'o// de nas lag len bzhin bri/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi gnas nye bar brgyan pa ni/ mchod pa'i rdzas/ rnal 'byor gyi yo byad tshang bar bsags la lag len bzhin du nye bar brgyan par bya'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la gsum las/ dang po mdun bskyed ni/

slob dpon bdag nyid khrus byas/ khar bdud rtsi ril bu bcug rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su stan nang tshangs can bting ba la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'dug ste/ 'byung gtor byin gyis brlab pa nas/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i bar dkyil chog gi gong du 'byung ba ltar bya/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing bdud rtsi'i bsangs gtor dkyil 'khor la byas pas/ thugs phyag mtshan rnams bkod pa la phog pas bdud rtsi'i thig ler gyur/ de las rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor thabs shes rab kyi ngang nas chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka che ba/ kha dog dkar po/ de'i nang du sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum/ de'i steng du rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam/ 'byung bzhi'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'khor lo de'i dbus su nā da cha gcig zhugs/ de rnams 'dres pa las rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba/ nang gi dbus su rdo rje'i phreng bas bcad pa'i le'u tshe lnga/ re re'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa/ phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad/ lte ba rnams su tshangs pa ser po dang dbang po dkar po gnyis mgo bo g.yas su blta ba/ nye dbang nag po dang drag po sngon po gnyis mgo bo g.yon du blta ba/ 'khor gnas thams cad du nyi ma/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nī la badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang māṃ mthing ga las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje

zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ dang laṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ lho yi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du dz+riṃ dang tāṃ ser po las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ nub kyi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du āṃ dang paṃ dmar po las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las snang ba mtha' yas dgyes pa rdo rje zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ byang gi pad+ma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du khaṃ dang tāṃ ljang khu las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las don grub dgyes pa rdo rje

zhes pa nas/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad dang sgo bzhir gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ tsaṃ ḍaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrnams las shar du gau rī ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu sogs nas dril bu bsnams pa bar dang*/ shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la paṃ tsaṃ bhaṃ yaṃ duṃ suṃ aṃ gaṃ rnams las rim pa de nyid kyis skam pa mo dkar mo sogs nas dri yi dung chos bar/ lho yi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la suṃ taṃ raṃ baṃ/ laṃ maṃ gaṃ naṃ rnams rim pa de nyid kyis nyi phyag ma dkar mo sogs nas rdo rje dang bcas gar byed pa bar/ nub kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la paṃ taṃ saṃ yaṃ/ paṃ taṃ duṃ muṃ rnams las rim pa de nyid kyis pad+ma dkar mo pad+ma sogs nas phyag gnyis 'bud dung bar/ byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la tsaṃ taṃ k+ṣaṃ kaṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ daṃ rnams las rim pa de nyid kyis rdo rje sgo lcags ma sogs nas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa bar/ lha mo de thams cad sogs nas me ri me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rang rang 'dra ba tshon gang ba de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje/ 'khor lo sogs tāṃ rnams las 'od zer dang bcas pa/ gtso bo he ru ka rigs lnga rnams kyi mig tu oṃ las sogs ro yi gdan gyi steng du bzhugs pa'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khe tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bhū tsa ri badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pa tā la wā si nī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas gnyis su med par bsre ba ni/ gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon lnga las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dgyes pa rdo rje rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i sta gon gyi lha tshogs rnams kyang gau rī dzaḥtsau rī hūm̐/

bai tā lī baṃ/ ghasma rī hoḥmadun bskyed dang gnyis su med par gyur/ lha sta gon ma byas na sta gon gyi lha bstim pa 'di mi dgos/ zhes mdun bskyed bsgrub/ de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gzhugs pa'i don du/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed ni/ he badz+ra/ rang nyid skad cig gis mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sogs/ tshogs bsags nas brtsams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas/ rigs so so'i 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad rang rang gi gtso bo'i zhal brgyad dang*/ sgo ma bzhi mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje'i thugs kar zhugs/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin la gtso bo yab yum gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas par bya'o// 'di'i dkyil chog dkyus su bzlas pa mi gsal yang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzlas pa mdzad par snang ba ltar na/ yum mā ma ki'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du māṃ gyi mthar sogs nas gtso 'khor gyi bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar bya'o// gsum pa mngal 'byin ni/ rang nyid gtso bo yab yum lnga po ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 'jug byas pas sid kyi sgras rigs lnga'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yang dag par bkug ste bdag nyid kyi kha'i lam du bcug nas/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste lha mo'i pad+mar phyung la/ de nas dkyil 'khor de nam mkha'i phyogs su 'thon te bzhugs par gyur/ hūm̐ gis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin/ dhu pe= gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin thog mtha' 'dra bas/ tsau rī tsaṃ= bai tā li baṃ= ghasma rī ghaṃ= puk+ka sī paṃ= sha wa ri shaṃ= tsaṇ+ḍā lī tsaṃ= ḍom+bi nī ḍāṃ= zhes lha mo brgyad kyi sngags 'ba' zhig gis phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ thugs rje thabs mkhas 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// chags pas 'dul mdzad bdag med ma la 'khyud// gdul bya'i dbang gis gar dgu'i rol pa mdzad// bcom ldan dgyes rdor sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// mgon po bde chen sku dang gnyis med yum// lha mo bdag med mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gtso// bha ga'i dbyings nas lha mo'i tshogs sprul ma// rdo rje bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// gzugs sogs phung po bzhi ni rnam dag cing*// ye shes rnam pa bzhi yi rang bzhin can// zhe sdang la sogs nyon mongs bzhi sbyong ba// gau rī ma sogs sgo ma bzhi la bstod// sa sogs 'byung ba bzhi ni rnam dag cing*// byams sogs tshad med bzhi yi rang bzhin can// mgon po bde chen thugs ni skul mdzad ma// puk+ka sī sogs mtshams ma rnams la bstod//

de nas dam tshig gi lhar/ gau rī dzaḥdam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐/ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ/ bcing*/ ghasma rī hoḥmi dgyes pa med par dgyes par gyur// ces dgug gzhug byas/ dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas/ slar yang gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i tshul gyis phyung nas des khams gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs la/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs lha mo brgyad kyi sngags gong ltar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams he ru ka'i rnam pa'i gzugs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid kyi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba na me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro// rnga'i sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// rdo rje'i glu spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis blangs bar bya'o// dbang bskur nas chu cung zad yar 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pa la rdo rje sngon po/ rnam snang la 'khor lo dkar po/ rin 'byung la rin po che ser po/ snang mtha' la pad+ma dmar po/ don grub la ral gri ljang kha/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bos dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas mdun bskyed la mchod pa rgyas par bya ba ste/ rdo rje bsang gtor gyi chu yi nang du bcug pa des mchod rdzas la gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas mchod rdzas kyi bgeg bskrad/ de nas lag pa rdo rje dang ldan pas mchod rdzas la bskor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlab/ des nas mchod pa ni/ yan lag bdun ldan ar+gha'i rgyun// gdung ba ma lus zhi byed ma// rgya mtsho'i khyon dang mnyam pa 'di// dad pas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ āḥ.ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

zhabs kyi pad+mo'i rnyog sel ma// lha yi dri bzang dag gi gter// gād+ga'i rgyun gyis rjes 'gro ba// dad pas= oṃ āḥpād+yaṃ= sbyin pa'i rang bzhin me tog char// sangs rgyas zhing du 'thor byed pa// zla ba'i mdog 'dzin 'dzum zhal ma// bde ba 'bar ba'i gar gyis mchod// oṃ āḥpuṣ+pe= tshul khrims rang bzhin bdug spos kyis// 'jig rten ma lus khyab byed pa// gnam ka'i lus ldan 'gying tshul ma// bde ba= oṃ āḥdhū pe= brtson 'grus rang bzhin byug pa'i dri// chos rnams thams cad dag byed ma// mar gad mdangs 'dzin snyems pa ma// bde ba= oṃ āḥgan+dhe= thabs kyi rang bzhin zhal zas kyis// rnal 'byor can rnams bde byed pa// gser sbyangs 'od ldan sgeg pa ma// bde ba= oṃ āḥnai wi d+yaṃ= bzod bsam shes rab rang bzhin 'od// phyi nang mun rnams sel byed pa// 'char ka'i gzugs can mtshar sdug ma// bde ba= oṃ āḥdī paṃ= stobs smon ye shes rang bzhin sgras// chos kyi phung po ston byed pa// nyi ma'i bkrag ldan dbyangs snyan ma// bde ba= oṃ āḥshap+ta= dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad kun yid kyis phul/ rang gi snying ga nas bde stong las byung ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan gyi rig ma bcu drug gi mchod par gyur/ pi wang ma dang gling bu ma// rdza rnga ma dang rnga bo che// bzhad ma sgeg mo glu gar ma// me tog ma dang spos 'chang ma// mar me ma dang dri chab ma// me long ma dang ro 'dzin ma// reg bya ma dang chos ldan ma// nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra bī ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ waṃ she= mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ ge= hā s+ya= lā s+ya= gīrti= nrīrti= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= dī paṃ= gan+dhe= rū pa= ra s+ye= spar+she= dhārma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyas par spro na rin chen sna bdun 'bul ba ste/ 'dzam bu'i gser las rang byung lte ba zlum// rtsibs stong mu khyud mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba// mkha' la rab 'phags phyogs las rgyal byed pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/

oṃ tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ thal dkar mche ba drug pa zla 'od can// chu zheng phun tshogs yud kyis mkha' lam nas// sa chen rgya mtsho'i ska rags can skor ba'i// glang po rin chen= oṃ hasti rat+na sogs gong bzhin/ spu kha rma bya'i mgrin 'dra yid 'ong zhing*// gser gyi rgyan ldan mgyogs pa yid lta bus// tho rangs sa rnams bskor te slar ldog pa'i// rta mchog rin chen= oṃ a shwa rat+na= kun tu sngo ba snang byed baiḍūr+ya// nyin mor byed pa 'od kyis rnam gnon cing*// bsam pa rdzogs byed legs sbyang cha brgyad pa// nor bu rin chen= oṃ ma ṇi rat+na= 'chi med bu mo bzhin du gzugs mdzes shing*// reg bya mchog gis lus sems bde byed pa// sgyu rtsal kun shes smra mkhas dri bzang gter// btsun mo rin chen= oṃ s+t+rī rat+na= phur bu'i blo ldan mdzangs shing yid gzhungs pa// 'khor yug gter gyi 'dod dgur 'dzud byed cing*// des pa snyan pa'i tshig 'byin lha mig can// khyim bdag rin chen= oṃ pu ru ṣa rat+na= sred med bu yi stobs ldan dpa' ba dang*// rtul phod yid la brgyus pa'i don rnams kun// mod la sgrub cing phas rgol med byed pa'i// blon po rin chen= oṃ khat+ga rat+na= 'od zer gyis sngo ral gri pags pa 'jam// dga' ba'i nags tshal gos ni yid rjes 'gro// mthu ldan mchil lahwam khang khyim gzhal du med// reg 'jam gzims cha= oṃ u pa rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ phung po'i bdud 'joms rdo rje gau rī ma// stong nyid rnam thar zhal gyi sgo skyong ma// ga pur zla ba bdud rtsis gdungs sel byed// rdo rje ma mo'i mchod pas deng dgyes mdzod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ swā hā/ nyon mongs bdud 'joms rdo rje tsau rī ma// mtshan med rnam thar zhal gyi sgo skyong ma// sih+la rang byung nyi mas nyin mor byed// rdo rje=

oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= 'chi bdag bdud 'joms rdo rje bai tā lī// smon med rnam thar zhal gyi sgo skyong ma// mi bskyod rnam dag bdud rtsis tshe 'dzin byed// rdo rje= oṃ bai tā lī baṃ= lha'i bdud 'joms rdo rje ghasma rī// rtsol med rnam thar zhal gyi sgo skyong ma// snang mdzad mchog gi sman gyis nyes sel byed// rdo rje= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= gshin rje'i gdon 'joms rdo rje puk+ka si// byams pa'i thugs kyis 'gro la rjes chags ma// sgron ma lnga yi bza' bas yid sim byed// rdo rje= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= gnod sbyin gdon 'joms rdo rje sha wa rī// snying rje'i thugs kyis 'jig rten rjes 'dzin ma// shes rab rang bzhin chang lngas myos par byed// rdo rje= oṃ sha wa rī shaṃ= srin po'i gdon 'joms rdo rje tsaṇ+ḍā li// dga' ba'i thugs kyis 'gro la bde sbyin ma// sna tshogs rol mo'i sbyor bas rna snyan byed// rdo rje= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= lha min gdon 'joms rdo rje ḍom+bi nī// mnyam nyid thugs kyis kun tu phan mdzad ma// yang dag sbyor bas mtha' yas bde ster byed// rdo rje ma mo'i mchod pas deng dgyes mdzod// oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ swā hā/ khyad par gyi mchod pa 'di nyid kyi rgyud las gsungs pa ni/ glu ni rdo rje can la dbul// gar ni sangs rgyas rnams la dbul// de bzhin dri ni nyi ma la'o// 'jig rten mchog la bza' dang bca'// gos kyi mchod pa rta mchog la// 'di rnams mchod pa dam pa ste// rdo rje mchod pa byas pa yis// rdo rje can kun mnyes par byed// a ka ru nag kye rdo rje// dmar po 'jig rten rje la dbul// gur gum rdo rje snang ba la// bdun gyi rgyal po thams cad de// hūm̐ rdo rje las byung ba'i dri// 'di rnams dri yi rab sbyor bas// dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob bo// kha dang tsha ba rdo rjer dbul// mngar ba rdo rje rtag pa la// skyur ba rdo rje nyi ma la'o// de bzhin lan tshwa 'jig rten dbang*// rta yi rgyal po thams cad dam// bska ba yang ni rab brtag bya// kyai'i rdo rje rdor can gyi// me tog mdog gnag rkang 'thung 'byung*// mal+li kā dang mā la tī// kun+da sangs rgyas rtag par dbul// shing gi dbang mchog dri med mchog

/snang byed la ni sbyor bar bya// dbang mchog dmar po'i chu skyes dang*// ban du dmar po pā ṭa laṃ// pad+ma gar gyi dbang la dbul// rta mchog rdo rje can la kun// rdo rje theg pas mnyes byed pa// 'di ni don dam mchod pa yin// zhes pa rnams kyis mchod do/ /nang gi mchod pa ni/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin// chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod// ro langs ma ni chu lag ma// ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin zhing*// puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin// gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*// 'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod// 'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas// g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid// oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsau rī tsaṃ= bai tā lī baṃ= ghasma rī ghaṃ= puk+ka sī paṃ= sha ba rī shaṃ= tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ= gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ ḍom+bi nī yis 'khyud pa las byung ba'i// 'pho med lhan cig skyes dga'i bde chen pos// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dgyes mdzad rigs lnga dang*// thabs kyi skur bzhengs mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo mchod/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri pā ra mahā su khaṃ pū dza āḥhūm̐/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ bde ba chen po'i nyams myong dran par byas la/ gang gis rnam rtog rnams spangs te// byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing*// lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa// 'di ni don dam mchod pa yin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ tshogs rdzas rnams kyi 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/ shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/

lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod pa bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u

lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ lha rnams kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa de las 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ phud dkyil 'khor la phul/ gtor ma rnams la'ang bran no// bstod pa ni/ oṃ mahā badz+ra hūm̐/ rdo rje dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe āḥ dril bu gzung la/ kun tu sems can thams cad kyi// sdig pa thams cad rnam sbyong zhing*// sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad pa// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba sdang bas non gzigs nas// gti mug kun tu zad bya'i phyir// mgon po rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// bud med kyis 'dul 'gro gzigs nas// bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid gyur// phyag 'os thub pa pha rol phyin// sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba rmongs pas gzir gzigs nas// gti mug thams cad zad mdzad pa// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che// zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba khengs pas gzir gzigs nas// nga rgyal thams cad zad mdzad pa// rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che// rdo rje dregs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba chags pas gzir gzigs nas// chags pa thams cad zad mdzad pa// rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste// rdo rje chags par phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba phrag dog gzir gzigs nas// thams cad kyis ni zad mdzad pa// rta bdun rgyal po rgyal po che// thams cad gzugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog

/gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// kye yi rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal// bdag med mas ni mgul nas 'khyud// dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar// zhal brgyad pa la spyan gsum pa// mgon po de la gus phyag 'tshal// spyi bo'i gdan steng nag po mdzes// dkar dang dmar po g.yas dang g.yon// gang gi lhag ma'i zhal rnams ni// gnas pa de la gus phyag 'tshal// glang po rta bong glang rnga mo// skyes pa khyi dang ma her bcas// g.yas pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i// thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// sa dang chu dang rlung dang me// zla nyi gshin rje gsang ba pa// g.yon pa'i phyag brgyad la gnas pa'i// thod pa 'dzin la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi po// mnyam par mnan cing gcer bu nyid// nyi mar zhabs g.yas brkyang mdzad sngo// gar mdzad de la bdag phyag 'tshal// 'khor lo bzhi yi bdag nyid mdzes// 'dzag pa'i mgo bos rnam par brgyan// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam dag pa'i// phyag rgya lnga yis yang dag brgyan// sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi bor mtshan// dpral bar rigs kyi bdag po nyid// dam pa'i dga' ba yang dag thob// bde chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal// gaṃ las skyes pa'i gau rī shar// yan lag gnag cing g.yon na nya// g.yas pa na ni gri gug 'dzin// tshangs pa mnan la= tsaṃ las byung ba'i chom rkun ma// btsod kyi kha dog lho phyogs su// phyag na phag dang cang te'u bsnams// dbang po mnan la= baṃ las skyes pa'i ser mo nub// ro langs ma ni nye dbang mnan// phyag g.yon lhung bzed g.yas pa yis// rus sbal bsnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// ghasma rī ni byang gi sgor// ljang khu ghaṃ las byung ba yi// phyag na sbrul dang thod pas brel// drag po mnan la= gshin rje mnan cing baṃ las byung*// g.yon na dgra s+t+wa seng ge g.yas// dbang ldan du ni 'jigs gzugs ma// phyag 'tshal puk+ka sī sngon la// ri khrod ma dkar shaṃ las byung*// me ru gnod sbyin steng du gnas// g.yon na gsil byed g.yas pa yis// dge slong bsnams la=

gtum mo nam mkha'i sngo bsangs ma// srin por tsaṃ las byung ba yi// g.yon na thod pa 'khor lo g.yas// phyag 'tshal srin po mnan khyod la// ḍaṃ las byung ba'i g.yung mo ni// rlung mtshams thags bzang ris stang gshegs// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub// sna tshogs mdog la bdag phyag 'tshal// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas// phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan// gcer bu spyan gsum thams cad la// bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phung po khams ni rnam dag pa// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// bde rab ster ni thams cad la// dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal lo// nyid kyi g.yas pa'i phyag bzung ba'i// phyag mtshan sa bon las byung ba'i// bde chen 'dod pa thams cad la// rtag tu yang dag phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig nyi zla kha sbyor nas sa bon// gnyis las skyes pa'i gtso bo rig mar bcas// nyid kyis nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la ni// 'jig rten gsum po sprul par mdzad dang ldan// 'di las 'di dag thams cad ma lus pa'i// zhi ba bde stsol rig ma sdud mdzad pa// shes rab chags pas bdud rtsi'i ro nyid kyis// gnas su zhi ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro ma gtso kyai rdo rje// lha mo 'khor lo bcas bstod pas// bdag gis bsod nams gang thob pa// des ni 'jig rten de mtshungs shog/ rgyas par spro na/ gang dang gang gi thabs mkhas kyis// sems can rnams ni 'dul gyur ba// de dang de yi cho ga yis// chos ni ston par mdzad la 'dud// zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang*// skye bo chags ldan phrag dog can// sgrib pa lnga po 'joms brtson pa'i// dpal he ru ka lngar phyag 'tshal// shin tu gdug cing drag pa la// zhi bas nye bar mi sbyor ba// mi bskyod ye shes 'byung gnas che// rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal// chad pa'i stong par zhen rnams dang*// med pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ni// 'dul phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gyur// rtag tu phan mdzad la phyag 'tshal// rnam par rtog pa'i ri rab dang*// nga rgyal chen po'i mun pa 'joms// rdo rje nyi ma rgyal chen po// rin chen 'byung ldan la phyag 'tshal// skye bo chags bral 'dod chen sogs// 'gro ba ma lus bde chen gyi// chags pas byang chub mchog stsol ba// pad+ma gar dbang la phyag 'tshal// theg pa gzhan gyis nges 'byung rnams// kun mkhyen lam la brten nas ni// rdo rje myur 'gro rang byung gtso// rta bdun rgyal po la phyag 'tshal// ye shes lnga la rab dga' zhing*// khams lnga'i rang bzhin rnam par dag

/nya dol ma dang lcags kyu 'chang*// me tog ma sogs mtshams su gnas// rnam snang 'khor rnams la phyag 'tshal// nyi ma 'dzin dang mar me ma// rin chen sgrol ma glog gi phyag /sgeg mo la sogs grwa bzhir gnas// rin chen 'khor rnams la phyag 'tshal// pad+ma 'dzin dang chos dbang phyug /lcags sgrog dang ni rang nyid 'khyud// gling bu ma sogs grwa bzhir gnas// pad+ma'i 'khor rnams la phyag 'tshal// rdo rje sgo lcags lde mig dang*// sgo glegs thogs dang gos 'dzin ma// spyan ma la sogs grwa bzhir gnas// las kyi 'khor rnams la phyag 'tshal// gdul bya shin tu rmongs pa'i tshogs// nye bar bzung ba ston pa'i phyir// skam pa la sogs phyag mtshan bsnams// gti mug 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal// rab tu gzi brjid 'bar ba yis// dregs pa'i mun nag sel slad du// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sogs bsnams// nga rgyal 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal// chags pa'i chu yis ma gos shing*// 'dod chags chos kyis bde bsgrub pas// pad+ma la sogs phyag mtshan bsnams// chags can 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal// phrag dog chen pos bsgribs pa'i mthus// yon tan sgo ni mi snang la// sgo lcags la sogs phyag mtshan bsnams// ser sna 'dul mdzad la phyag 'tshal// dgug pa'i las byed lcags kyu ma// zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu yis// 'ching sdom 'bebs shing dbang mdzad pas// sgo ma bzhi po la phyag 'tshal// mkha' dang bem po dang ba dang*// go skabs med dang rab 'byed pa// sna tshogs rdo rje'i gzhir gnas pa'i// gzhal yas khang pa la phyag 'tshal// 'dir ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das// mkha' 'gro ma yi rdo rje gur// lhag pa'i lha nyid gcig pu las/ du mar snang la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes rgyud kyi nges pa la brten pa'i bstod pa rgyas pa yang bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bstod pa'i rgyas gdab bya/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/

rngog lugs su gsal kha ma gsungs kyang phyag len tu skabs 'dir mdzad de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rigs so so'i 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad rang rang gi gtso bo'i zhal brgyad dang sogs bdag mdun thun mong sgrub thabs ltar sdud cing sngags 'khor bkod la/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyi bzlas pa sta gon du bshad pa ltar ci 'grub byas pa'i rjes su mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ slar yang so so'i 'khor gyi lha mo rten dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ zhes dang*/ bdag la dmigs te/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis/ zhes pa nas/ rang nyid gtso bo yab yum du gsal bar gyur/ bzhi pa thun mthar gtor ma btang ba ni/ mgron bskyed pa nas smon lam gdab pa yan sgrub thabs ltar bya'o/ /rngog lugs zang ma byed na bstod pa'i rjes su bden pa bskul ba la 'jug pas 'thus kyi nang gtor yang ma bshad do// lnga pa sgrub mchod zhag mang du sbrel na skabs 'dir bum bskyed/ bzlas pa/ las bum phrin las bcol ba'i bar sta gon skabs ltar bya'o// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ spos kyi reng bu thogs dril bu bsil zhing*/ dam tshig gi glus nye bar spyod par bya ba ni/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje 'dzin par bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa med pa brtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyis rjes su chags// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid bdag sgrubs shig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems su bdag gi bdag /dngos grub chen po mchog gi mchog /dbang phyug chen po rgyal bas rgyal// grub pa'i rdo rje cher gsal ba// rdo rje snyems par bdag sgrubs shig

/sems can kun gyi yid khyab pas// sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab nyid de// 'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog/ de nas bden pa bsgrag par bya ste/ shes rab thabs dang dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// mgon po khyod kyi bden pa des// bdag gi 'dod pa skong gyur cig/ ces brjod do// dam tshig glus bskul 'di bdag 'jug gi rjes su mdzad pa'ang phyag bzhes khungs mar 'byung*/ bzhi pa slob dpon bdag 'jug ni/ de nas bdag nyid kyi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir phyi rol tu 'byung po la gtor ma btang ba ste/ sgrub pa'i grogs rtsa sngags bzla bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi srung bar bzhag slob dpon sogs dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol tu phyin cing sa phyogs gtsang mar dbus su mchod gtor/ g.yas su chu gnyis/ g.yon du mdun nas rgyab tu brtsams te nyer spyod phreng tshar/ mdun du nang mchod chu snod sogs 'du byas la/ mdun du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang gi steng du pad+ma dkar po dang*/ bar du nag po dang*/ 'og tu dmar po rnams 'dab ma brgyad pa brtsegs pa/ rang gi spyi bo'i sku rdo rje las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas gzugs med srid pa'i lha tshogs nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i bar gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od kyis bsdus nas mdun gyi pad+ma dkar po'i dbus su oṃ dkar po cig tu gyur/ snying ga'i thugs rdo rje las 'od zer nag po 'phros pas phyogs skyong bcu dang pha ma la sogs pa 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma nag po'i dbus su hūm̐ nag po cig tu gyur/ mgrin pa'i gsung rdo rje las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas sa steng gi mi/ sa 'og gi klu/ dmyal ba yi dwags byol song thams cad 'od kyis bsdus nas pad+ma dmar po'i dbus su āḥdamar po cig tu gyur/ yi ge gsum po de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/

sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥyis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas tshur 'dus pa las 'khor lo las sku rdo rje sku mdog dkar po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ rdo rje las thugs rdo rje sku mdog nag po rang 'od kyi rig ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ pad+ma las gsung rdo rje sku mdog dmar po rang 'od kyi rigs ma dang zhal sbyar ba/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' gsum spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥ tsau rī hūm̐/ bai tā lī baṃ/ gha sma rī hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas la/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas sku rdo rje la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje la snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ yang rang gi gnas gsum gyi lha las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te mchod par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥham̐'u baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dud kha gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu tha ma gnyis ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ nang gi dbus su mi'i sha dang byang chub kyi sems/

shar du glang po che'i sha dang dri chen/ lhor rta'i sha dang dri chu/ nub tu ba lang gi sha dang rak+ta/ byang du khyi'i sha dang brgyungs pa/ de rnams kyi phyi'i rnam pa oṃ/ srog āḥde'i steng du zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse mo la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgo thur du blta ba/ rlung gis me sbar thod par bsros/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga khol bas/ oṃ dang āḥlas 'od zer spros te zla phyed rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi phab/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres par gyur/ oṃ āḥham̐'u

lan gsum brjod/ mthar zla phyed rdo rje yang thod pa'i nang du lhung ste zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gtor ma'i mgron thams cad kyi ljags kyi rtse mo las rdo rje nas 'bru tsam pa de las 'od zer sbu gu can byung bas gtor ma la reg ste 'od zer gyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs nas gsol bar gyur/ oṃ in+d+ra/ ya mā/ dza la/ yak+ṣa/ bhū ta/ ba ni/ wā yu/ rak+ṣa/ tsan+d+ra/ sur+ya/ mā ta/ pa byā tā la/ pa tā la/ aṣ+ṭa/ sa byā swā hā/ i daṃ/ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dziṃ ga puṣ+pe/ dhū pa/ maṃ sa/ bid+ga/ at+ma/ sarba/ kañdza swā hā/ khan+ti/ khu ti/ pe ta ga ta/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇī ad+ya nut+pan na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod pas phul la/ dbang po mthar byed chu bdag dang*// nor sbyin dri za bden bral rlung*// 'byung po sa lha 'khor dang bcas// tshangs dang zla nyi la sogs gza'// gzhan yang tshangs ris dam pa dang*// tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa nyid// dga' ldan dang ni 'thab bral ba// rgyal po chen po bzhi yi ris// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams dang*// gang zhig 'phrul dga' yi ni lha// gtsang ma'i gnas na gang dag gnas// bde ba can na gnas rnams dang*// 'og min gnas na gnas pa dang*// 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gnas// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa rnams// klu chen stobs rgyu dung skyong dang*// de bzhin mtha' yas nor rgyas nyid// 'jog po dang ni rigs ldan te// pad chen pad+ma bzang po can// lha min sems can dmyal bar bcas// rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun rdzogs mdzod// ces pas las bcol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ muḥ gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ nye reg bya zhing nang du 'ong nas 'khod la/ khrus byas te maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos bdag nyid la tshig rnams brjod pa dang dbang bskur bar

bsam zhing*/ dngos su bdag nyid kyis slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang blang ngo*// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yog bsangs la bcings te/ rdo rje lag tu gtad de yol ba'i nang khrid par mos la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dpag tu med pa spros te dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes dang*/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sngags/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṇāṃ/ na maḥsaman+ta dharmā ṇāṃ/ na maḥsaman+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ oṃ pra t+yaṅgir/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra brti/ sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra/ mū la karma/ ban+dha naṃ/ tā ḍa naṃ/ kī la naṃ bā ma ma kṛ te ye na ke na tsi ta kṛ tan+tā tra/ sarban+tu/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ mā ra mā ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces brjod cing gu gul gyi dud pas bdug yungs kar gyis brdeg cing bgegs bskrad/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod su yin zhes dris la/ slob mas bdag skal ba bzang po can lags/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma bdag nyid rab tu gzhug par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// de nas khyed rang rnams dang por shar phyogs kyi sgo yid kyis phye ste shar gyi lha snam du 'dug par mos la dkyil 'khor gyi la phyag mdzod cig

oṃ na māste hūm̐/ oṃ na mā mi hūm̐/ oṃ na mo na mā mi hūm̐/ de bzhin du lho/ nub/ byang rnams nas kyang phyag bya'o// sems rigs lnga'i lha dgu'i zhabs la btud pa'i phyag byas pas shin tu mnyes par bsam mo// slar shar gyi lha snam du 'dug par mos la lnga rnam dag bya snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ de yang dang po sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// rjes su yi rang ba ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams la// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston byed cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol// skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas dang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta ba// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ de bzhin du ni sems bskyed do// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig brtan par gyur pa 'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen gyis ni gzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar gyis// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya//

zhes pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa dang*/ gang phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang gsungs// de bas de la brnyas pa ni// rtsa ba'i ltung ba dang por bshad// bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa ni// ltung ba gnyis pa yin par bshad// rdo rje spun la khros pa ni// nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin// sems can rnams la byams pa spong*// bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs// chos kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems// de spong ba ni lnga pa yin// rang ngam gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'// chos la smod pa drug pa yin// yongs su ma smin sems can la// gsang ba sgrogs pa bdun pa yin// phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid// de la brnyas byed brgyad pa yin// rang bzhin dag pa'i chos rnams la// som nyi za ba dgu pa yin// gdug la rtag tu byams ldan par// byed pa de ni bcu par 'dod// ming sogs bral ba'i chos rnams la// der rtog pa ni bcu gcig pa// sems can dad ldan pa la// sems sun 'byin pa bcu gnyis pa// dam tshig la ni ji bzhin brnyes// mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa// shes rab rang bzhin bud med la// smod par byed pa bcu bzhi pa// sngags pas 'di dag spangs na ni// dngos grub nges par thob par 'gyur// zhes rtsa ba'i dam tshig kyang dbog go /de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa bsgrags pa tsam gyis mi chog nges par khas blangs pa'i sgo nas bsrung dgos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te mchog tu gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis sgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces pas sdom pa khas len du gzhug de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog nag po zhal brgyad zhabs bzhi phyag bcu drug pa sogs me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs pa gsal thob byas la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags dang*/ las bum gyi chus bsangs pa'i me tog 'phreng ba/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes thal mo'i bar du byin la snying gar bcang*/ slob dpon gyis snying gar rdo rje'i dri chu dang bcas pa gzung ste/ oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes rnal 'byor du sems bskyed/ zhes brjod nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la lha'i dam bsgrag pa 'di brjod par bya ste/ de ring khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes snying gar rdo rje bzhag ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// mna' chu blud pa bdud rtsi ril bu chang dang sbyar ba thod par blug ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ to da ka hūm̐/ de nas slob dpon gyis dam bsgrag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ ngas gang byos shig bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig

/khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ de nas ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal he ru ka bdag la phob cig ces lan gsum brjod du bcug la/ bdud rtsi lnga'i chu sbyin la/ 'o khyod rang mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa de'i mtha' na snying po'i sngags me mar gyi rnam pa ltar dmar lhag lhag pa gsal bar sgoms shig dar zhig kha rog bsdad de/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus pha gi na bcom ldan 'das sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon hūm̐ sngon po dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po breng ma chad pa na ra ra byung nas khyed rang gi snying khar zhugs pas des rkyen byas khyed rang gi lus 'od du mer mer zhu ba la shes pa gtod la/ gzhan gang la'ang sems yengs su ma 'jug cig ces brjod la dril bu gsil zhing mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs sems la shar bar bsam/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i rgyun dang ldan pas/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ marda marda badz+ra dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ a āḥ zhes btags pa brjod de ye shes dbab/ de nas khyed rang rnams rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po sogs me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su bh+rum̐ dkar po 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa de'i mtha' na snying po'i sngags me mar gyi rnam pa ltar dmar lhag lhag pa gsal bar sgoms shig dar zhig kha rog bsdad de/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi le'u tshe'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon bh+rūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po breng ma chad pa na ra ra byung nas khyed rang gi snying khar zhugs pas des rkyen byas khyed rang gi lus 'od du mer mer zhu bar bsam la/

oṃ shā shwa ta pa ra ma shā shwa e dz+yo hi dzi na dzika phaṭ swā hā/ a āḥ zhes ye shes dbab/ de nas khyed rang rnams rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa ba'i zhal ser po sogs me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su dz+riṃ ser po 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa de'i mtha' na snying po'i sngags me mar gyi rnam pa ltar dmar lhag lhag pa gsal bar sgoms shig dar zhig kha rog bsdad de/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lho yi le'u tshe'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon dz+riṃ ser po las 'od zer ser po breng ma chad pa na ra ra byung nas khyed rang gi snying khar zhugs pas des rkyen byas khyed rang gi lus 'od du mer mer zhu bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra sūr+ya ta ma bi dha ma na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ rat+na dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ a ā zhes ye shes dbab/ de nas khyed rang rnams snang ba mtha' yas dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa ba'i zhal dmar po sogs me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su aṃ dmar po 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa de'i mtha' na snying po'i sngags me mar gyi rnam pa ltar dmar lhag lhag pa gsal bar sgoms shig dar zhig kha rog bsdad de/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nub kyi le'u tshe'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i snang ba mtha' yas dgyes pa rdo rje sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon aṃ dmar po las 'od zer dmar po breng ma chad pa na ra ra byung nas khyed rang gi snying khar zhugs pas des rkyen byas khyed rang gi lus 'od du mer mer zhu bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hu lu hu lu ā ro lik phaṭ swā hā/ a ā

zhes ye shes dbab/ de nas khyed rang rnams don yod grub pa dgyes pa rdo rje sku mdog dang rtsa ba'i zhal ljang khu sogs me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i dbus su khaṃ ljang khu 'od zer lnga dang bcas pa de'i mtha' na snying po'i sngags me mar gyi rnam pa ltar dmar lhag lhag pa gsal bar sgoms shig dar zhig kha rog bsdad de/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi byang gi le'u tshe'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i don yod grub pa dgyes pa rdo rje sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon khaṃ ljang khu las 'od zer ljang khu breng ma chad pa na ra ra byung nas khyed rang gi snying khar zhugs pas des rkyen byas khyed rang gi lus 'od du mer mer zhu bar bsam la/ oṃ phu phu phu hi hi hi pradz+nyā dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ a ā zhes ye shes dbab/ sku gsung thugs phebs pa'i rtags byung na dang*/ ma byung na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la ye shes pa yang dang yang du bcug nas gong bzhin phab na phebs par 'gyur ro// phebs na de snang mtha' lce la a dmar po cig bsgoms te/ smos shig bu yis dge mi dge zhes brjod pas dge mi dge thams cad ston par 'gyur ro// slob dpon gyis spos chus brlan pa'i lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pa spyi bor bzhag nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas brtan par byas nas/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar khrid de/ dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog ji lta bu mthong zhes dri/ des kyang dkar po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ ljang khu dang*/ nag po dang*/ khra bor mthong zhes smra na/ rim pa bzhin du/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ mngon spyod dang*/ las thams cad pa 'grub pa'i snod du 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan no// de nas 'di skad du/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya// lha rnams kyi ni rigs ji bzhin// ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog

/pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes brjod la me tog gi 'phreng ba dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dor ro// de yang gtso bo rigs lnga la phog na mchog gi dngos grub/ 'khor rnams la thun mong gi dngos grub/ pho brang gi nang du tshud na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob pa yin la/ lan gsum bskyar yang pho brang gi nang du ma tshud na nges par skal pa med pa'o// de nas me tog gi 'phreng ba blangs la/ sems can stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu gzung bar bgyi// ces pas me tog gi 'phreng ba mgo la bcings/ slob ma'i mig 'bras gnyis su oṃ re bsgoms te/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// ces brjod pas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ slob dpon gyis/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad par rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs te// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kyang*// thams cad 'di la mngon du 'gyur// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyong*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis/ dkyil 'khor dbus kyi ling tshe'i pad+ma'i lte ba la bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ 'dab ma brgyad la gau rī la sogs pa lha mo rnams bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor shar gyi ling tshe'i pad+ma'i lte bar rnam snang dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ 'dab ma brgyad la skam pa mo la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor lho'i ling tshe'i pad+ma'i lte ba la rin 'byung dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ 'dab ma brgyad la nyi phyag ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor nub kyi ling tshe'i pad+ma'i lte ba la snang mtha' dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ 'dab ma brgyad la pad+ma ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams bzhugs/

dkyil 'khor byang gi ling tshe'i pad+ma'i lte bar don grub dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ 'dab ma brgyad la sgo lcags ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo na lcags kyu ma/ lho sgo na zhags pa ma/ nub sgo na lcags sgrog ma/ byang sgo na dril bu ma rnams bzhugs/ rten dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha snam/ pañtsa re khā'i rtsigs pa/ sgo rta babs dang bcas pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ rin chen pha gu/ dra ba drwa phyed/ dur khrod brgyad/ rdo rje'i ra ba dang phyi rol tu me ri 'bar ba'i khor yug yin no// de las kyang khyod kyi me tog phog pa'i lha ni 'di yin no// zhes dkyil 'khor la dbyug gu sogs gtad cing bstan no// de nas dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dbang bzhi las bum dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// de ltar yon tan 'byung la sogs// de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon bgyid// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi steng du/ steng du gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs kyis brgyan pa la rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas 'khod par mos shig las sngags kyis bsangs/ rak+ṣa sa bsrungs la/ slob ma swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las khyed rang hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal cig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur pa la mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dpag tu med pas dbang bskur bar

bsam la/ 'khor gyi bum pa'i chu rnams gtso bo'i bum par bsdus te dngos su slob dpon gyis thogs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po pa// khams gsum kun gyis phyag 'tshal ba'i// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum las// rab tu byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ dha ra dha ra sogs rigs lnga'i sngags tshan re re'i sham du oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag cing chu blug pa dang*/ kha gdong bkru ba dang*/ khyor gang 'thung du gzhug 'o khyod la chu'i dbang bskur bas kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas me long lta bu'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// slob ma dang dbu rgyan las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las aṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgron ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dbang rdzas la ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ yid kyis mchod/ swa rat+na dhṛka rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum/ slar dbu rgyan gyi gzugs su gyur pa lag tu gzung ste mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bar bsam la/ thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes mgor bskon/ khyod la dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// de nas slob ma dang rdo rje bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum gos dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsnang ba mtha' yas yab yum slar rdo rje'i gzugs su gyur pa lag tu gzung ste/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas rdo rje gtod par bsams la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyed la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// zhes lag pa g.yas par gtad la/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// slob ma dang dril bu bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdon yod grub pa yab yum slar dril bu'i gzugs su gyur pa lag tu gzung ste/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas dril bu gtad par bsams/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// dril bu 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya staṃ/ zhes lag pa g.yon par gtad la/ dril bu'i dbang skur bas sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// slob ma bsangs la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa'i brdar/ mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pas ming gi dbang bskur bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya'o// de'ang dbus kyi ling tshe la me tog phog na/ slob ma skyes pa la rdo rje bzhad pa/ rdo rje rnam par sgeg ma/ rdo rje ldem pa dang gsum/ bud med la/ rdo rje snyems ma/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ rdo rje e ma'o bde ma/ rdo rje bdag med ma dang bzhi po gang rung zhig gdags/ de bzhin du shar gyi le'u tshe la phog na/ skyes pa la/ rdo rje rol pa/ rdo rje bde ba/ rdo rje bde ba'i myu gu dang gsum/ bud med la rdo rje spyan ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje ser mo/ rdo rje sgyu 'phrul ma/ rdo rje 'bar ma/ rdo rje lcugs ma mo/ rdo rje shugs can ma/ rdo rje ro langs ma dang brgyad/ lho'i le'u tshe la phog na/ skyes pa la/ rdo rje yid bzhin nor bu/ rdo rje yan lag med pa/ rdo rje shes rab myu gu/ rdo rje snying rje'i myu gu/ rdo rje mchog tu dga' ba/ rdo rje dga' ba bde ba/ rdo rje rnam par snang byed dang bdun/ bud med la rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ rdo rje skor ma/ rdo rje phreng ba mo/ rdo rje sgeg mo/ rdo rje bzhad pa mo/ rdo rje stobs ma/ rdo rje kha gyes ma dang bdun/ nub kyi le'u tshe la phog na/ skyes pa la/ rdo rje pad+ma/ rdo rje pad+ma'i myu gu/ rdo rje a la la/ rdo rje pad+ma'i lcags kyu/ rdo rje ye shes dang lnga/ bud med la rdo rje pad mo/ rdo rje 'byung gnas ma/ rdo rje gos gter ma/ rdo rje chags pa ma dang bzhi/ byang gi le'u tshe la phog na/ skyes pa la/ rdo rje 'bebs pa/ rdo rje nam mkha'/ rdo rje pha rol tu phyin pa/ rdo rje chags pa dang bzhi/ bud med la rdo rje sgrol ma/ rdo rje do shal ma/

rdo rje rnam par sgeg ma/ rdo rje blo ldan ma/ rdo rje kang ka ma/ rdo rje kha chu ma/ rdo rje dbugs 'byin ma/ rdo rje lag pa mo dang brgyad po gang rung zhig 'dag go/ de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas ming gzhi'i phung po gnas gyur nas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// des ma rig pa lnga gnas gyur te rig pa'i ye shes lnga mngon du byed pas rig pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas khyed rang rnams stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i bdud bzhi'i gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje zhes sogs nas bzhugs par gyur bar sgrub thabs bzhin sgom du bcug la/ gri gug dang thod pa dril bu btags pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'brel ba'i tshangs skud ḍā ma ru rnams bsangs sbyangs la/ a las byung ba'i gri gug shes rab kyi rang bzhin lag pa g.yon dang*/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i thod pa thabs bde ba'i rang bzhin lag pa g.yas su gtad/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gru mor bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rje bcas// dril bu sil sil sgra sgrog cing*// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pā la// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// de rnams dang ldan pa ni/ zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang dang*/ drag po dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ rmongs par bya ba dang*/ dgra'i sde 'jigs pa dang bsad pa la sogs pa de rnams la thogs pa med pa sgrub par byos shig mchil lahwam bgo ba dang*/ char dbab pa dang*/ nyi ma dang zla ba gzung ba la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma'i dngos grub thams cad ni ci dga' bar sgrub par gyis shig de ni las kyi tshogs dang thun mong dngos grub rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas dam tshig gsum gyi dbang sbyin pa ni/ slob ma rnams pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/

g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i skur sgoms shig rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// lag pa g.yas par sbyin te/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa dbyer med du rtogs par bya ba'i blos zung zhig snying khar 'dzin du bcug thugs kyi dam tshig go/ dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bshad// srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// lag pa g.yon du gtad/ des kyang*/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong sems can thams cad la sgrog par bya'o snyam pa'i blos dkrol/ gsung gi dam tshig go/ khyed rang rnams me tog phog pa'i yi dam gyi lhar skad cig gis sgoms par gsungs kyang spyi khyab tu slob ma

bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum gyi skur skad cig gis sgoms shig yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir// phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bshad// dam tshig yid ni brtan pa gang*// de phyir phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes brjod la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byed du bcug la/ dus 'di nas gzung nas yi dam gyi lha dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar gyis shig sku'i dam tshig go/ de nas rigs lnga'i rjes gnang sbyin pa la so so'i phyag rgya byed du gzhug pa'am/ phyag mtshan gtad kyang rung ste/ slar khyed rang rnams rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur gsal thob cig 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis gdul bya gti mug can rnams kyi don gyis shig de bzhin du/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ snang mtha'/ don grub rnams su sgoms shig byas la/ 'jig rten khams ni zhes sogs dang*/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis gdul bya zhe sdang can rnams kyi don gyis shig de bzhin 'gres te/ rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis gdul bya ser sna can rnams kyi don gyis shig pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// khyod kyis gdul bya 'dod chags can rnams kyi don gyis shig las kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ khyod kyis gdul bya le lo can rnams kyi don gyis shig de dag ni rigs lnga'i rjes su gnang ba lnga ste/ sangs rgyas nas gdul bya dug lnga dang bcas pa'i sems can rnams la rigs lnga'i gzugs gzung nas gdul bya'i don tshegs med par 'byung ngo*// de nas slob dpon g.yon pas dril bu dang bcas pa'i snam sbyar gyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar byas la/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya byas nas/ oṃ 'dir ni ngas khyed lung bstan yin// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton/

shrī he ru ka nā ma/ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ya staṃ/ bhur+bhu waḥswa/ khyod kyi gzugs kyi phung po dang gti mug rnam par dag pa ni gau rī ma'o// tshor ba'i phung po dang ser sna rnam par dag pa ni tsau rī ma'o// 'du shes kyi phung po dang 'dod chags rnam par dag pa ni bai tā lī'o// 'du byed kyi phung po dang phrag dog rnam par dag pa ni ghasma rī'o// rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rnam par dag pa ni yum bdag med ma'o// 'byung ba sa rnam par dag pa ni puk+ka sī'o// chu rnam par dag pa ni sha wa rī'o// me rnam par dag pa ni tsaṇ+ḍa lī'o// rlung rnam par dag pa ni ḍom+bi ni'o// mig gi dbang po dang mig gi rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni gti mug rdo rje ma'o// rna ba'i dbang po dang rna ba'i rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni zhe sdang rdo rje ma'o// sna'i dbang po dang sna'i rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni ser sna rdo rje ma'o// lce'i dbang po dang lce'i rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni 'dod chags rdo rje ma'o// lus kyi dbang po dang lus kyi rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni phrag dog rdo rje ma'o// yid kyi dbang po dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa rnam par dag pa ni reg bya rdo rje ma yin pas khyod rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mor lung bstan pa'o// de ltar lung ma bstan par sngon bdag gis ma shes/ rang gi phung po khams skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mor 'dug pas de re dga' snyam du mdzod// ces gzengs bstod/ bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'das pa'o// khyod ni tshe thog ma med pa nas khams gsum 'khor bar 'khor/ ngal ba don med 'ba' zhig tu song*/ da ni bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur ba dang*/

dam tshig dang sdom pa ni thob pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad la 'jigs pa med par byos shig thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgom pas nges par 'tshang rgya'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ rdor dril gtad la 'khyud pa'i tshul byed du gzhug cing*/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyar ba// slob dpon dbang du rab tu brjod// ces slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo bstan/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid// che dang dril bu chen po gzung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes slob ma'i lag tu rdo rje dril bu gtad de/ des kyang*/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong bshad cing slob ma bsdu bar bya'o snyam pa'i blos/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil bar bya'o// de ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnang ba rjes su sbyin pa'o// slar yang slob ma rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa la slob dpon gyis rdo rje gtad/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brten// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka ya s+t+waṃ dhā ra yā mi/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐ zhes slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par gtad la/ de lan gsum du gsor te snying gar bzung du bcug la/ 'o khyod kyis 'jig rten pa'i spyod pa thams cad brtul nas gsang sngags kyi spyod pa la 'jug par bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par byos shig de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas spyir lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag khyad par lus kyi dri ma dag nas rgyud nyan pa dang bshad pa dang bskyed rim bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa bya ba dang*/ gtor ma gtang du rung ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'o// de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du

maṇ+ḍal dang rig ma phul la/ gsang ba'i dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod ni he ru ka dpal te// bde gshegs rnams kyis bde stsol mdzad// byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi// yang dag don mchog rnams dag pa// ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yis// mchog gi dbang ni bskur ba bzhin// de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi// sdug bsngal dag ni bsal bar mdzod// rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig nyes pa'i rab rib 'joms// gang gi bla med byang chub pa// de 'dir bdag gis thob par mdzod// ces lan gsum brjod la/ slob dpon bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mā ma ki sku mdog sngon mo/ khro ba'i zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon la brten pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthil g.yon pa'i brla la gtad de skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis me phung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi lha mo rang dang 'dra ba spyan drangs/ gau ri dzaḥ dam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐ gzhug bai tā lī baṃ bcings/ ghasma rī hoḥ mi dgyes pa med pa dgyes par gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum chu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ yang rang gi gnas gsum las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te mchod par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dhū pe= gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya=

ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bskyed cing*/ de la ye shes kyi lha mo bstim pa dang*/ dbang bskur nas mchod/ de nas de'i snying ga lte ba/ gsang gnas/ lkog ma/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug tu dri'i thig le byas/ de rnams su rim pa bzhin mi bskyod pa sngon pa rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ don grub ljang khu ral gri dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje 'chang dkar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ snang mtha' dmar po pad+ma dang pad+mas yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rin 'byung ser po rin po che dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa thams cad kyang zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsgoms la mchod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir gdong ras dmar pos bcings la/ yid kyis slob dpon sgyu ma lta bu'i sku la/ mos gus rtse gcig pas g.yon bskor lan gsum byas par soms shig byas la ye shes pa dbab pa'i don ni rang byin gyis brlab pa bstan pa/ kyai yi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa'i// de bzhin bdag gis sad mdzad pa// rdo rje mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bshad kyis 'dod pas rab tu nyon// lha mo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur// rangs par gyur te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der thal mo sbyar bas btud de bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung nyan to// zhes bshad/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas slob dpon lus kyi dkyil 'khor du me tog gtor la/ sems can stobs can khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu gzung bar bgyi// zhes slar sbyin/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs dkrol/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pa ni// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur//

zhes dang*/ 'khor ba spangs nas gzhan du ni// mya ngan 'das pa rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ bum pa'i dbang gi dus su phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin la de bas zab pa 'di rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor yin te/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa yin// zhes pas/ slob dpon bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje yab yum du gnas pa'i thugs ka na mi bskyod pa/ dpral ba na rin chen 'byung ldan/ lte ba na don yod grub pa/ mgrin pa na snang ba mtha' yas/ gsang ba'i gnas na rdo rje 'chang*/ spyi bo na rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa yin no// zhes lus kyi lha ngo bstan la sngar gyi me tog phog pa'i ming gis gdags so// de nas slob dpon bdag nyid he ru kar gsal bas 'od kyi rig ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa byas te thig le phyung bar bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal byas la 'o ma dang bdud rtsi lnga sbyar te mtheb srin gyis slob ma'i lce la bzhag cing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin gsang ba'i sems rgyun gyis// do nub khyod la dbang bskur ro// a hoḥsu kha/ zhes brjod la/ byang chub sems kyi thig le de khyod rang rnam pa'i lce thog tu skya phung yod par sgoms la lce yar rkan la sbyar te/ rtsa a wa dhū ti mda' smyug tsam pa'i mar sna rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo dang*/ yar sna lce'u chung la zug pa'i nang na mar byang chub sems kyi thig le lce thog tu skya chi li li song bas lus thams cad la bde ba phri li li skyes par bsgom/ zag pa med pa'i bde stong dbyer med kyi don la shes pa lhan ne gtod cig khrag chen po ni ga pur bcas// tsan dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar// de bzhin rdo rje chu dang bcas// lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad// sangs rgyas kun dang mthun par gsungs// dam tshig 'di ni bla na med// bzang po khyod kyis bskyang bar bya//

zhes dam tshig phog la mig dar bsal lo// des spyir lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag khyad par ngag gi dri ma dag nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten pa dang*/ zas kyi rnal 'byor byar rung ba dang*/ rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi rdzogs rim bsgom du rung ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'o// dbang gsum pa'i don du byang chub sems kyis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung gru gsum zlum skor gnyis kyi nang mdzes par lha mo bco lnga'i tshom bu bkod/ mthar mchod pa dang tshogs kyi yo byad bshams/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa dang brgyad pa rim pa gnyis kyi lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la ro dang nyi ma'i gdan la lha mo bco lngar skad cig gis gsal ba ni/ dbus su mā ma kī/ phyogs bzhi'i shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor bsang ba'i gau rī/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ phyi skor gyi shar du dkar mo/ lhor chom rkun ma/ nub tu ro langs ma/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa ma/ nub byang du ḍom+bi nī/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ steng du mkha' spyod ma rnams sku mdog nag po/ khro mo'i cha byad can/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa dmar ba/ phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa rnams gri gug dang*/ g.yon pa rnams na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung du bcug pa/ stag gi lpags pas smad dkris pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i ro'i steng na skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis gnas pa/ me ri dang me dpung gi nang na bzhugs par gyur/ gtso mo'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi lha mo spyan drangs/ gau rī dzaḥ dam tshig sems dpa'i mgo thog tu ye shes sems dpa' dgug tsau rī hūm̐ gzhug

bai tā lī baṃ bcings/ ghasma rī hoḥ mi dgyes pa med pa dgyes par gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur bas/ gtso mo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ yang rang gi gnas gsum las mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te mchod par gyur/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dhū pe= gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyas par ram bsdu na oṃ a ā sogs dbyangs yig bcu drug gi mthar oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ ces tshogs kyi mchod pa phul nas mnyes par byas/ de nas slob mas yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor ci bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la de stsol cig /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs dag tu// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs//

zhes lan gsum brjod la chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir gdong g.yogs bcings la/ chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor la g.yon skor lan gsum yid kyis byas par mos la ye shes dbab pa ni/ khyed rang rnam pa'i rkang pa gnyis gshibs kyis gshibs la langs te lus thang sha bcad la thal mo sbyar nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ dbang po lnga'i 'jug shes bsdus te/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dbus su mi shigs pa'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam de la rlung bcug ste ma yengs par bya'o// de'i don/ snying ga'i dbus na zla ba gnas// zla ba'i gzugs las mi shigs pa// sna tshogs 'od kyi rnam 'khrigs ldan// des na rdo rje rnam par bsgoms// rdo rje bdag med ma mkha' 'gro// bskul ba'i cho ga bsgom par bya'o// mkha' 'gro ma yi sna rtser ni// yungs kar rnam par gnas par bsgom// khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i// 'gro ba ma lus yungs kar du'o// de lta bur ni bsgoms gyur na// rang byin brlab pa rab tu 'grub// ces pa ste dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyod rang gi snying gar mā ma kī sku mdog sngon mo g.yas na zangs kyi gri gug dmar yag ge ba/ g.yon na thod pa dkar tse re ba khrag gis dmar phyur re bkang ba bsnams pa/ rus pa'i rgyan chas dkar chabs se brgyan pa tshon gang ba cig sgoms shig ces yang yang bya'o/ /slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mā ma kī sku mdog sngon mo/ g.yas na gri gug dmar yag ge ba/ g.yon na thod pa kar tse re ba khrag gis dmar phyur re bkang nas bsnams pa nyung 'bru tsam mang po byung ste/ khyod rang gi lus me re re gang bas bde ba skyes par sgoms shig ces yang yang brjod/ sngags gong gsal brjod cing spos dang rol mos byin dbab/ ma phebs na spog pa'i cho ga ni/ khyod rang gi smin mtshams su rus pa'i chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa cig sgoms shig

de'i nang du g.yung drung ris dmar po cig dmar sga ra ra 'khor bar sgoms shig ces sngags sogs bskyar bas phebs par 'gyur ro// pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor du me tog dor la gdong g.yog dkrol/ de nas lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so zhes pa dang*/ gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na// thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs// zhes gsungs pas// gsang dbang gi dus su slob dpon lus kyi dkyil 'khor yin te/ de bas zab pa 'di chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor yin/ de yang chos 'byung gis ni bde stong mtshon la/ de na bzhugs pa'i lha yang bde stong dbyer med las ma 'das par bstan to// zhes chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor du lha ngo bstan la/ rdo rje snyems ma zhes sogs kyi ming gis gdags so// sher dbang dngos ni/ de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod rdo rje zhal phyag rgyan cha thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od kyi rig ma lha mo mā ma kī phyag na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa shin tu mdzes shing gzhon sha chags pa bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod tsam pa zhig byung nas khyed rang rnams la gtad par gyur/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes brjod la/ de dang snyoms par 'jug pa byas pas dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong ba khyad par can rgyud la skyes par sgoms shig yang khyed rang rnam pa'i lte ba na gtum mo ye shes kyi me reg bya tsha ba rno ba gdung ba cig dmar nar gyis 'bar ba la shes pa gtod la bde ba phri li li skyes par sgoms shig

byas la/ slob dpon gyi mtheb srin gyis slob ma'i rtsa rba rlabs btsir la sgom du bcug pas rtogs pa'i sgro 'dogs gcod cing lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes shar bas dbang bskur ba zhes bya'o// de ltar chags grol gnyis ka'i mtshon byed du mdzad cing*/ spyir da lta phyag len du grol lam kho na'i dbang du byas pa ste bshad rgyud kyi dngos bstan chags lam gtso bor byas pa ni man ngag brgyud pa las shes par bya'o/ /des spyir lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag khyad par sems kyi dri ma dag nas chags can gyis las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa dang*/ chags bral gyis lha zhal sbyar gyi bskyed rim dang gtum mo bsgom pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'o// dbang bzhi pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la tshig dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang chen bka' drin gyis// 'dir ni dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// stong nyid shes rab mdzes pa yi// bzhi pa'i bka' drin stsal tu gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ de ltar dbang gsum pa'i dus su spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar gtan la phab nas/ bzhi par tshig gis gtan la dbab pa ni/ phyi nas de nyid yang dag bshad// rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang*// 'khor ba rnam par byang ba dag /khyad par cung zad yod ma yin// mchog dgar bsgom pa med cing sgom pa po yang med// lus kyang med cing gzung ba med cing 'dzin pa'ang med// sha dang khrag kyang med cing bshang dang gci ba'ang med// skyug bro rmongs med gtsang sbra mchod phyir thogs med dang*// chags med sdang ba med dang rmongs med phrag dog med// ser sna med dang nga rgyal med cing mthong bya med// bsgom dang sgom pa med cing bshes dang dgra med dang*// rlom sems med pa'i lhan cig skyes pa sna tshogs nyid// ces pa dang*/ ye shes 'di ni che phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha' dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar 'byin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha//
