zhes gsungs so// dbang 'di'i khyad par kyi dam tshig kyang*/ rtsa rgyu rtag pa gnyis pa'i le'u gsum pa las/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya// rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra ba dang*// khyod kyis ma byin par yang longs// pha rol bud med bsten par gyis// sems kyi srog chags gsod pa nyid// gang phyir srog ni sems su brjod// 'jig rten bsgral ba zhes bya ba// rdzun gyi tshig tu rab tu brjod// btsun mo'i khu ba ma byin par// gzhan gyi bud med rang nyid mtshungs// zhes nges pa'i don rgya cher gsungs pas shes bya'o// de ltar dbang bzhi pa bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma dag nas phyag rgya chen po sgom du rung ba'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa'o// dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba la/ mdun du chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i steng du pad+ma dkar po dang sogs nas gtor ma'i mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ bar sgrub thabs ltar btang*/ de nas chos skyong lcam dral gyi gtor ma gtong*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa gong du ma gtang na 'dir bya'o// de nas las kyi he ru kas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ kyai gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa phag /rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol// zhes lan gsum gyis rtog pa dgrol/ slob dpon gyis/ bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi mchog /'dod chags dri ma med pa 'di// gzung 'dzin rnam par grol ba yi// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// a hoḥsu khaṃ/ brjod cing tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma bsdus/ slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su bskor zhing*/ bdud rtsi'i kha phru btab la/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mkha' 'gro ma dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor nag mo 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis lhag ma'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di hab di ri ri gsol bar gyur/

dur khrod bdag mo brjod gtor ma gtsang sar dor/ shin tu lhag ma bsdus te bdud rtsi bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ a kā ro lan gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ 'byung po phud la mi re zhing lhag ma la dbang ba phyi rol sgo gdong na gnas pa rnams la sbyin no// so so zas skom gyis tshims par gyur cig /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsams pa kun// de dag thams cad ci rigs par// thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig/ de nas/ kol+la i reṭ+ṭi a bo la/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ṭā ho badz+dza i/ kā ru ṇe ki a i ṇa ro la/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza ī ga ḍeṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pā ṇi a i/ du na dhu ra badz+dza a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tsha tu ri si h+la kaspu ra lā i a i/ mā la i in+dha ṇa sā li dza/ ta he bhi ru kha i a i/ pheṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ shud+dha a shud+dhaṇ+ṇa ma ṇi a i/ ni raṃ su aṅga tsa ḍi wi/ ta hiṃ sa ra wa pā ṇi a i/ mā la a tso kun+tu ru bā ḍa i ḍaṃ ṇ+ḍi ma te hiṃ ṇ+ṇa badz+dza a i/ ces mngon rtogs bzhin du rdo rje'i glu blang*/ yig brgya brjod/ slob ma rnams kyis bla ma dang*/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum bya zhing yig brgya brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod par bya ste/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bgegs bskrad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis mchod rdzas thams cad bde stong du byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoṃḥkhaṃ raṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ ni ri ti hūm̐ khaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du dhū pe'i gnas su

gan+dhe= nai wi d+ya= ā lo ke= lngas mchod/ oṃ gau rī gaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ thog mtha' 'dra bas/ oṃ tsau rī tsaṃ= oṃ baitā lī baṃ= oṃ ghasma rī ghaṃ= oṃ puk+ka sī paṃ= oṃ sha wa rā shaṃ= oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī tsaṃ= oṃ ḍom+bi nī ḍaṃ= zhes mchod / sgrub mchod kyi nyin tha mar tshigs bcad bcas rgyas par bya'o// kun tu sems can thams cad kyi// sdig pa thams cad rnam sbyong zhing*// sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad pa// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba sdang bas non gzigs nas// gti mug kun tu zad bya'i phyir// mgon po rgyal ba rnam snang mdzad// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// bud med kyis 'dul 'gro gzigs nas// bdag med rnal 'byor ma nyid gyur// phyag 'os thub pa pha rol phyin// sgyu ma'i phyag rgya phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba rmongs pas gzir gzigs nas// gti mug thams cad zad mdzad pa// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che// zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba khengs pas gzir gzigs nas// nga rgyal thams cad zad mdzad pa// rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che// rdo rje dregs la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba chags pas gzir gzigs nas// chags pa thams cad zad mdzad pa// rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste// rdo rje chags par phyag 'tshal bstod// 'gro ba phrag dog gzir gzigs nas// thams cad kyis ni zad mdzad pa// rta bdun rgyal po rgyal po che// thams cad gzugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes pas bstod/ de nas lhag chad bskong ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ gtso bo nus pa mchis shing*// ma tshang ba dang lhag gyur dang*// gang yang 'gal bar gyur pa rnams// de kun bzod par mdzad par rigs// gsang sngags nyams dang bya ba nyams// cho ga nyams par gyur pa gang*// de yang khyod kyis bzod par mdzod//

ces bzod par gsol/ rigs su skyes dang dam tshig can// smyo med kyai yi rdo rjer ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing*// 'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog /byang chub rdo rje bsngags pa yi// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang*// bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog/ ces brjod rang don gyi thun mtshams thams cad kyi mthar ye shes sems dpa' mi gshegs la/ gzhan don thams cad kyi thun mtshams su gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba rje btsun nā ro pa'i bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa'o// de nas/ he badz+ra maṇ+ḍal muḥmadun bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams// 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyi rten la bstim pa'am rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rdul tshon gyi nub tha ma la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsal// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra mu/ zhes pa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur bar mngon rtogs bzhin no// rdul tshon a kā ro 'i sngags kyis 'phyag la klu chog gis chu bor dor/ thig dang bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams mi mngon par bya'o// bla ma la yon phul/ bkra shis brjod pa ni/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs grub pa// dgyes pa rdo rje 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab bdag med pad+ma la ni rdo rjes rol// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig pad+ma dmar po ge sar bcas// 'dab brgyad la gnas lha mo zhal brgyad la phyogs shing*// rol thabs sna tshogs kyis ni gtso bo mnyes par byed/

bden pa= rab dmar spyan gyis dus gsum gdul bya la gzigs shing*// nang stong la sogs bcu drug phyag gis dug gsum sel// bsdu dngos zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi 'joms mdzad pa// bden pa des= log rtog bsal phyir dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar// sgeg pa la sogs rol dgu'i cha byad rab tu gsal// 'khor lo la sogs phyag rgya lnga yis rab tu brgyan/ bden pa des= me long la sogs ye shes bzhi las grub pa'i sku// gau rī la sogs phyogs kyi pad+ma la gnas pa// tshangs pa la sogs bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ bden pa des= byams pa la sogs tshad med bzhi las grub pa'i sku// puk+ka sī sogs mtshams kyi pad+ma la gnas pa// gshin rje la sogs bdud bzhi zhabs kyis gnon mdzad pa/ bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgor gnas pa// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i lha mo bzhi// ye shes dgug gzhug 'ching dang dbyer med nyid mdzad pa// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje// spyan ma dang bcas lha mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor// gzugs dang gti mug rnam dag me long ye shes nyid// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rje// rig ma dang bcas lha mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor// tshor ba nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes nyid// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig snang ba mtha' yas kye rdo rje// gos dkar dang bcas lha mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor// 'du shes 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ye shes nyid// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig don yod grub pa kye rdo rje// sgrol ma dang bcas lha mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor// 'du byed phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes nyid// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi rnams dang*// yang dag spong ba rdzu 'phrul dbang po stobs la sogs// byang chub phyogs rnams sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa// bden pa des=

bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang*// 'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod mchog ni rab tu bkod pa dang*/ mu tig drwa ba rin chen nyi zla gser gyi dril bu dpyangs// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig rta babs pad+ma 'khor lo gdugs kyis phub// mdzes pa'i ri dwags ba dan bcu drug legs brkyang ba// rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu dam pa'i chos sgra sgrogs// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod brgyad kyis legs bskor ba// shīr+ṣa la sogs byang chub shing brgyad gnas pa la// glang chen gdong can la sogs brgyad po gnas pa yi// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa yi// rnam par mi rtog ye shes mchog gi dur khrod du// 'jig rten chos brgyad dag pa'i phyogs skyong tshogs gnas pa/ bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad rang bzhin gyi// ljon shing la gnas byang chub sems kyi zhing skyong mchog /bsam gtan ri bo lhag mthong rdo rje'i mchod rten bcas// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig byams pa'i yan lag sprin tshogs 'khrigs/ thugs rje'i chu bor rtag tu dga' bde'i klu dbang gnas// dngos grub brgyad kyi bdag nyid grub chen du ma bzhugs// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig shes rab snang ba'i me rnams 'bar/ kun rtogs sna tshogs dag pa sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gyi// mkha' lding 'byung po sha za yi dwags ro langs rgyu// bden pa des= bkra shis gang zhig rnam thar sgo gsum mtshon pa yi// chos 'byung dbus son dri med pad+ma 'dab brgyad ldan/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i gzhi// bden pas des= bkra shis gang zhig mi shigs srung ba'i 'khor lo ni// bden gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur// ye shes me yi 'od kyis bdud dang nyon mongs sreg /bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog/

ces bkra shis brjod cing me tog char du bsnyil nas dge legs kyi snang bas khyab par bya'o// de ltar rje btsun mar rngog gi phyag bzhes rdo rje gur rigs bsdus kyi cho ga 'di yang*/ pad+ma dkar pos gur gyi srog shing bzhin rtse chen pho brang du sbyar ba thams cad mchog gi dngos grub la 'jug pa'i sgo chen por gyur cig gur rigs bsdus/ klu sgrub/ til+li/ nā ro mar rngog gnyis/ ram rdo rje grags/ bka' lung gnyan sgom pa/ mnga' ris pa byang chub tshul khrims/ rgya pho ba lung ba/ bla ma rgyal bo dga'/ bla ma seng ge sgra/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rngog don grub dpal/ byang chub dpal/ rgyal dbang rje/ a wa dhū ti pa/ chos kyi grags pa/ bla chen tshe bdag des bdag la'o/// / de ltar gur rigs bsdus kyi cho ga kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung sor bzhag dang*/ dbang dang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga kye rdor lha dgu'i sgrub dkyil dngos grub gter mdzod la bye brag dmigs bsal rnams 'don pa bsgyur ba'i khyad par tsam du gsungs pa ltar dbang dang sgrub mchod sogs la 'jug pa bde bar khrigs chags bklag chog tu ngag dbang mthu stobs tshul khrims bstan 'dzin gyis khungs ldan gyi yig rigs dag la go bstun nas bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro kun khyab bdag he ru ka'i go 'phang mchog la 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
